notes.title: Arcane Illumination - Update v0.14.9.4
notes.notes:
Hey Shopkeepers!

We're incredibly excited to bring you another patch today!
We've got a couple of cool new items that should help you light the way on your adventures and some all-around improvements to various systems!

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hip lantern accessory
[*] Option to keep items on death
[*] New light spell
[*] Cloaked electricity wiring
[/list]

[h2]Hip Lantern Equipment[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b38802b69d859cb998e9b61c5ea9501e80776fd7.gif[/img]

One piece of feedback we often get from newer players is that maneuvering and surviving at night can be difficult.
While you can always sleep in a bed to avoid the night, sometimes you're out in the middle of an adventure when dusk falls, and you have to get home in the dark. Torches are great for this but can be a little hard to juggle alongside your normal weapons and equipment.

In the late game, you unlock the waist light, which solves a lot of this for you, but we wanted to introduce an earlier game tool for hands-free light: the Hip Lantern.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e93ecb11bc1e8fef2f97e6999e4f19d8c6055bba.gif[/img]

Put together with scrap and charcoal, it's not as powerful as the waist light, but we hope it will help fill the gap for your nighttime adventures while you work on researching up to the late game.

The key binding for turning on and off the waist light will work for the hip lantern as well.

[h2]Keep Items On Death Option[/h2]
We're adding an option to disable dropping your items in a death box so you can customize your experience if you want to.

The intended goal of the death box mechanic is to have players eventually overcome the challenge through dimensional insurance with Ambrosia. More recently, we have also made some improvements to the quality of life for this mechanic with the introduction of Burke's death box recovery service in Kazai Village.

However, we are big proponents of allowing you all to play the game the way you want to and have the most fun. So, after hearing that this feature was still frustrating to some players, we added the option to turn it off this patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/76b35aa30a841e2e419f80e4084fe47784d88f22.png[/img]

When you're setting up your lobby, tick on the [b]Keep Items on Death[/b] option, and then when anyone in your lobby dies, they will keep all of their items and not drop a death box.
The 20% Telemed fee from your held money remains right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/bdb6fefdcee829ae03a5fedef2de84c4cf882711.png[/img]

Burke and Ambrosia will know if you have this setting on so you don't inadvertently waste money on death box related features with this option enabled.

This setting has also been enabled for the [b]Peaceful Shopkeeping Experience[/b] preset in dedicated servers.

[h2]Light Spell[/h2]
While we were creating the hip lantern, it got us thinking about what other useful illumination tools we could add. One that we ended up really enjoying is a light spellbook.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1f04694459ff0045e7257d4c359f698c939380e7.gif[/img]

This spell can be purchased from [spoiler]Rohbar Doun or Lili Hunt[/spoiler].
It provides more comparable light to the waist light but is more area-based than directional.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8b865d27c3eb6751b8a8d46d4fde3bcb64f2e58a.png[/img]

While you have to cast the light spell every 5 real minutes, it doesn't take up an accessory slot, and it has some additional arcane functionality!

By default, the light orb will follow you once you cast it, but you can cast again using the spellbook to send the orb out in front of you around 10-15 meters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e7fd11483e6d1d67c06a8523f5843797c6d74eb9.gif[/img]

While the orb is moving away from you, you can right-click with the spellbook to stop it from moving and right-click again to call it back to hover near you.

With the orb hovering near you, you can cast it to an enemy where it will hover near them to light up your target during a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/63d903e0c97842be8923c591d7a970dd88b8cfe6.gif[/img]

You can also disperse the orb manually by right-clicking when it is hovering near you while you are standing still.

We've been enjoying using the spell as hands-free light, a scouting tool, and a support role in combat at night. We hope this adds another exciting spell to your repertoire.

[h2]Expanded Healing Spell Functionality[/h2]
For the light spell, we added additional input functionality to spellbooks. This has allowed us to implement a very commonly requested spell-related feature: self-healing for the healing spell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/28f26edcd0a58a74dcae27b62e11ed02f40b2c93.gif[/img]

As before, you can left-click to cast the spell and heal your friends, but now you can also hold block (right-click) to heal yourself!

Healing yourself will consume hunger as all spells do, but this change brings a lot more use and fun to this spell.

[h2]Cloaked Electricity Wiring Tool[/h2]
Another frequent request we've seen is the ability to hide electricity wires, and we're excited to say that this update adds a new wiring tool that creates invisible wires!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/3d241fbcc2bd78f46f503d6c61d4fbad5bd1c428.gif[/img]

Visible wires are meant to give some fun depth to setting up your electricity grid where you have a purpose for wiring your electronics out of sight and in maintenance gaps.
However, many players wanted a more straightforward way to hide the wires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a259b47e552d55fbef94d5935bba5dfdebc4969d.png[/img]

That's what the Cloaked Electricity Wiring Tool allows. Wires placed with this tool are invisible and can only be seen when holding a wiring tool.

[h2]Visible Electricity Wiring Tool Range Increase[/h2]
To give the normal wiring tool its own niche and reward players who tackle the challenge of visible wire management, we have also greatly extended the wire length for the visible wiring tool.
The cloaked wiring tool keeps the same length as the wiring tool had in previous versions of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ed859bec7cf407adcaabf90743fdfa84329fc958.png[/img]
[i]Old max wire distance (front) vs new, longer max wire distance (rear).[/i]

We hope that this means the most optimal wiring solution will be combining visible and invisible wires.

You can use visible wires in your backroom warehouse areas for the longer range and then transition to invisible wires for the last leg to get to the electricity item inside your shop itself.

[h2]Stamina Potion Rework[/h2]
We've felt for a while that stamina potions were not as useful as the other potions and consumables. To improve their usefulness, we've reworked them to give stamina over time, similar to health potions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ef48e84fe766fc371a5ba581c221efbf4b9e0a17.gif[/img]

This should allow you to drink stamina potions during a fight - or even before - and benefit from improved stamina regeneration during your combat or test of endurance.

[h2]Updated Hot Spring VFX[/h2]
We saw that the Island's healing hot springs weren't getting the use they deserved, partially because the previous VFX looked a little foreboding and scary.
They should now look a lot more like a hot spring in which you want to rest and recover.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/37ba2b5c2f638c8d287caa3f185f55e4f4c9166d.gif[/img]

The VFX looked this way following an optimization pass many updates ago, and for this update, we were able to overhaul the visuals to look a lot more steamy and inviting without compromising on the previous performance optimizations!

Come on in, the water's warm!

[h1]Community Corner[/h1]
For today's community corner, we have an absolutely mind-blowing build to share from player [b][i]Tayron LAYDES[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/01872a03ea6256c78c5b887f6a9ff1579592d39b.png[/img]

This huge carbon-iron skyscraper is an engineering marvel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/747741a2bf3edc7d5970027faa31212b808fe239.png[/img]

Inside, each floor has rooms with different themes, from cafes to fish markets to concert halls. And you can't forget the bathrooms, which look pretty nice themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1ec1285cd8a5180368544eb7b857b703b7925233.png[/img]

The employees are even dressed up like important NPCs, which is super cool to see.

[i]Tayron LAYDES[/i] says they're not done decorating the build, so hopefully, they'll share it with us again when it's all finished. We are very impressed.

If you want to share your creation, post it in the #share-your-creations channel on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/Saleblazers]Discord[/url]. 🔨


[h1]v0.14.9.4 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9573479168048f2eabb3744459de479106ba6cd8.png[/img]


[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new hip lantern accessory
[*] Added a new lobby option to disable dropping items in a death box on death
[*] Added a new light spell
[*] Added a cloaked electricity wiring tool
[*] The healing spell can now heal the user
[*] Stamina potions now refill stamina over time
[*] Overhauled the Hot Springs VFX
[*] Torches now craft 3 at a time so players can get more of them more easily
[*] Candles now use plant fiber instead of charcoal to craft so players can still make light sources without charcoal
[*] Increased the light amount and cone size for the electrical waist light so it is still a major improvement over the hip lantern
[*] Increased the damage for the Kinkara-hitsujikai-tanken ([spoiler]Leyasoon's dagger[/spoiler])
[*] Slightly increased the damage for the Kinkara-hitsujikai-tachi ([spoiler]Leyasoon's sword[/spoiler])
[*] Increased the HP for the scrap bar item so it drops more scrap when destroyed
[*] Removed the sound that plays when equipping an item that has been enchanted with radiation after player feedback
[*] Added large bamboo cluster seeds to the seed shop in Kazai Village
[*] Adjusted the orientation of the pet rocks when placed in displays so they face outward
[*] Plot Seller NPCs no longer run in fear when they see violence
[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized electricity icon and wire rendering and batching
[*] Optimized electricity power propagation logic to improve loading time for shops with lots of electrical items
[*] Upgraded and optimized some packages that were causing some stuttering lag
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused save file metadata to get scrambled, causing the game to not recognize your save file in the load screen
[*] Fixed various issues with crafting employees not simulating properly
[*] Improved the employee simulation logic so they no longer favor specific randomly selected displays, improving the distribution of items sold
[*] Fixed some simulation timestep inaccuracies
[*] Using the healing spell on an NPC should no longer cause them to get mad at you
[*] Fixed the reading lamp sometimes becoming invisible in shops
[*] Fixed Clay Moore introducing himself even after you have already met him
[*] Fixed a bad Chinese translation in Ambrosia's dialogue
[*] Fixed various disconnect exceptions
[/list]


[h3]🖥️ Dedicated Server[/h3]
Because of the new items and system changes to things like electricity, we have incremented the version compatibility for dedicated servers with this patch.
You will have to save and close your server, update the console tool, and rehost to play with users on version number 14.9.4

[h3]📜 Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[strike][*] If you rename your save file, there is a chance the game will no longer be able to load your save from the load game menu.
We discovered this was an issue that was live on the previous patch as well, so if this has happened to you already, the next hotfix should resolve it for you.
So, for the time being, please do not rename your save file.
[*] Electric furnaces are sometimes not simulating properly while you are away
[/strike]
[/list]
[b]Hotfix 14.9.41 is now available that resolves these issues.[/b]

notes.title: Craft from Storage - Update v0.14.9.33
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!

We hope you are all having a great week so far.
We've got a new patch for you, which has some highly requested features and improvements, both for standalone lobbies and dedicated servers, as well as several fixes to improve your experience.

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] Craft from storage option
[*] Backup save system rework for increased stability
[*] Full headless server support for dedicated servers
[*] Improved server management access for dedicated servers
[*] Various optimizations
[/list]

[h2]Craft from Storage[/h2]
Many of you have said this was the number one feature missing from the game, so we're incredibly excited to bring it to you now. We hope it smooths out crafting and makes interacting with a lot of different systems more enjoyable.

Thank you to everyone who provided this feedback, especially those of you who spoke to me on the Steam Forums about how to best add this feature. We appreciate it!

Crafting stations will now be able to utilize resources from any container within ~45m of the station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2a29aa0666bf987c460948af14834d1a372f9168.gif[/img]

This quality of life improvement only applies to items crafted directly by you. So, if you want to automate things without your input, you'll still need to set up your employees to do so.

When discussing this feature with some of you, we also heard that some players prefer the immersion and micro actions of the current system, so we wanted to make sure to provide the ability to turn this feature off.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f571da69568453c91769d0dedac6fe79e451c6e2.png[/img]
You can use this toggle to turn off the ability to craft using resources in containers in the [b]Gameplay Settings[/b].

This can be configured for each player individually, so if your friend wants to craft from storage but you don't, they can turn it on, and you can turn it off and still play together!

In dedicated servers using the permission system, crafting from storage is bound to the [i]Container Access[/i] permission.
So if someone has container access in an area you manage, they will be able to craft from storage with containers in your area. If you want to prevent them from doing so, make sure to limit their container access.

Craft from storage excludes any container that has the Output Items toggle turned off in the employee settings from craft from storage eligibility.

[h2]Reworked Backup Save System[/h2]
With this patch, we also completed a major overhaul of the backup save system.

Previously, the game would keep your last 3 autosaves and allow you to roll back your world or character to them if you ran into any issues or needed to roll back for any reason.
However, these autosaves were overridden fairly frequently, which meant that sometimes an issue already infiltrated all 3 available backups by the time it was discovered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/850fb7157f4749f7c97a15310b36d0ddd7747cd2.png[/img]

To address this, we have moved 2 of the available backup saves into their own section and set them up to be manually saved and loaded.

Now you will have access to your [b]latest autosave as well as 2 manual save slots[/b] that you can manage and name however you'd like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e3dc6ec29a44715cd97fcf440a8103478570fbc7.gif[/img]

This updated save system can be found in a new [b]Save[/b] section in the ESC menu.

You can keep these manual backup saves for as long as you'd like or save over them as often as you'd like.
Maybe you want to make a manual backup before logging off every night. Or you want to make one before embarking on a risky journey. It's totally up to you!

Using these saves often will hopefully address any lingering rare issues with the save system if you run into any issues with your progress.
Hopefully, you will have 2 meaningfully placed backups and your last autosave to roll back to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8ff8e99eb7c055256d76ac777b59c500efac7f6b.gif[/img]

[h2]Save File Thumbnails[/h2]
You may have noticed in the new backup save system that the UI has been updated with some additional information to help you figure out which file you want to load, including an image of your character where you made the save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/6ec79ce61580315ca442a177fc2d957167ea5d91.gif[/img]

We also expanded this functionality to the loading UI for the main menu, so you can identify which file is which and remember which character you were using on that file more easily.

[h2]World Map Shop UI[/h2]
To help you more easily keep track of your shops and check in on their status from wherever your adventures take you, we've improved the shop UI on the world map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5f785bc7d9d2e6a9467ab78e440e48eabc7ddae5.png[/img]

You can now see your shop name and star rating at a glance. You can hover over your shop icon to get a readout with more details, including your shop level, average beauty, and, most importantly, open status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1d454e08d4043b36c9ab0e4a1fe69d15d5464424.png[/img]

We hope this smooths the flow for checking in on your shops and managing worlds with many different shops. It also gives you a little reminder of how well your shopkeeping empire is running while you're out adventuring.

[h2]Particle Effect Optimization[/h2]
As you know, we are always looking for places to improve performance.
We've received feedback from those of you with specific performance issues and are looking into various solutions to improve them both in the short term and with longer-form reworks.

A short-term improvement that should help a lot of lower-end systems and specific use cases where a lot of things are happening on screen is a rendering optimization for many of the particle VFX throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d83193e7d9af794876d1e0108fea4db47cf47f54.gif[/img]

We have reduced the rendering cost of these systems by about 10x with very little visual change.

This optimization will be most noticeable when there is a lot of VFX playing, but it will also help a bit for generic performance as there are many minor particle effects that play throughout normal gameplay.

The effects that received this optimization include:
[list]
[*] Smoke from fires
[*] Explosions
[*] Particles from damaging and destroying items
[*] Particles from picking up and placing items
[*] Particles from blood VFX
[*] Particles from dashing
[/list]

[h2]Mouse Button Bindings[/h2]
Another usability feature a lot of players have requested is the ability to bind controls to their mouse buttons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/3580961f0f38f6b56c240f21260c4b97036e664e.gif[/img]

This patch adds the toggle to the controls tab in the options menu. If you enable it, you will see another row of binding options for every available action that listens to the mouse buttons specifically. You can set an additional binding to any action for a mouse button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ed92e7850fb7362ff5a837ef7eff39602ab0cf6e.png[/img]

This way you can bind reload to MB5 as well as R, or whatever configuration you'd like!

[h1]🖥️Dedicated Server[/h1]
[i]New Tool Version: win_release_net48_v1.0.0-beta4[/i]
[i]Main Game Version Compatibility: v0.14.9.33 - v0.14.9.39[/i]

This patch features a substantial number of usability updates to our dedicated server tool to accommodate more setups and environments and make sure it is easily usable.
To get more information on the usage of these new features, please check out the[b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385724580]Updated Dedicated Server Guide[/url] [/b]in the guides section!

We also recently updated the Dedicated Server tool to show up in your[b] Steam Library under the Tools section[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a721de6ed0280f62f6f3851f640867f6be387464.png[/img]

So if you did not love using SteamCMD to access the server, you can now install it directly from your Steam Libary!

[h2]Full Headless Support[/h2]
Dedicated servers can now be run on a headless machine without needing a console to control it. All you need to do is launch the .exe with some extra arguments.

[h2]Server Admin Client[/h2]
You can now assign a list of SteamIDs as admin players of your server. 

Admin players can open the server console in the game while playing and execute all the available commands on the server side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9ca0a4a791d58942b6f22b75e72160ff1b4d5c51.gif[/img]

If you are running a full headless setup, make sure to assign at least one admin so that you can control your server mid-session.

[h2]Server Configuration File[/h2]
You can now save and start your server from a configuration JSON file with one extra launch argument.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5f3853152e9348758bd9ed69ecccacaacae86a93.png[/img]

You can use this whether you are running a full headless setup or not. Check out the guide for instructions on how to create and load one!

[h2]Server Game Version Compatibility Tolerance[/h2]
Your dedicated server will now match a range of main game versions instead of checking for an exact match.

This means you will no longer have to close down your server to update the game for minor hotfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7718e7fc1f8a6690a4efa0b6a2256ba73231c27c.png[/img]

You can see the range of compatible game versions when you open up the server.

Major updates will often be outside of this range and require an update and restart of your server in order to add new content or large reworks.
But this system should make maintaining a dedicated server across smaller updates a little less of a hassle.

[h1]Community Corner[/h1]

User [i]That Guy[/i] shared this incredible build on the Smithrock Shop Plot that I wanted to showcase for you all in this patch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f5019849b08261de671e14bed27fa6cb3ef88888.jpg[/img]

The complexity and detail of this compound are really well done here! It looks very cozy on this rainy day in the trees. Nice work, [i]That Guy[/i]!

User [i]lil beeb [/i]shared this very intricate brickwork build on the Dojo Shop Plot that I thought you would also want to see.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9acc6614d51133150e59526beca27fdf914f1659.png[/img]

The beams definitely look necessary to hold this marvel up, but they're done in a way that adds an incredible flair to the build. One of the most interesting exteriors I've seen. And so tall, too!

If you have a cool build or screenshot you want to share, feel free to post it in the #share-your-creations channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/sapTNUNYR3]Discord[/url].

[h1]v0.14.9.33 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/aeb7e91178d11d5d0930095d3041e8c528831893.png[/img]
[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a craft from storage option to the menu
[*] Added a new manual backup system for save files
[*] Added thumbnails to save files
[*] Added functionality to bind actions to mouse buttons
[*] Added the shop name and star rating to the world map
[*] Introduced a hover display for shops from the world map
[*] The building hammer UI now displays 5 items across to reduce scrolling
[*] Slightly reduced the forward movement caused by the casting animation for spellbooks
[*] Slightly reduced the damage for the charged attack on katana weapons
[*] Removed some water and waterfalls in the Desert
[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the loading and unloading of the research tree to reduce lag when using it
[*] Greatly reduced the rendering impact for many particle FX throughout the game
[*] Optimized saving and loading from file operations
[/list]

[h3]🗣️ Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the German translation based on player feedback
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the police could continually attack players after they were killed
[*] Fixed the building UI being cut off on certain resolutions, such as on the Steam Deck
[*] Failing to join a lobby will now time out the user and kick them back to the menu instead of getting stuck
[*] Fixed an issue where a host could see their own lobby after quitting and rejoining multiple times
[*] Fixed the new dialogue audio setting not adjusting some dialogue audio properly
[*] Fixed entering in player chat box to type does not block player input and movement after a map transfer
[*] Fixed some incorrect colliders in the Desert
[*] Fixed the bridge leading to the golf cart shop
[*] Fixed Samantha Cole's interaction name

[*] Fixed a case where a client could still see the minimap UI after placing a minimap item from their hotkey bar
[*] Fixed a case where clients would see employees with messed up clothing colorways

[/list]


[h3]🖥️ Dedicated Server[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full headless server support
[*] SteamID based admin list for users who can launch the console and control the server completely from inside the game
[*] Server config file support

notes.title: Dedicated Server Tool Beta
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!

We're incredibly excited to be bringing you the [b]Saleblazers Dedicated Server Console (Beta)[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b6eccdea539513304e4acb88c8d9305f2f2f8b82.png[/img]

You can host persistent servers for your friends and even host or join public lobbies with player permission mechanics and additional player slots.

We are releasing this tool in beta because it is overwhelmingly the most highly requested feature for the game, and we want to get it into your hands as soon as possible. We're looking forward to seeing how you use it and improving it over time alongside the rest of Saleblazers.

Please be aware that just for this initial beta testing phase, we may have to temporarily disable the ability to join dedicated servers if there are any major instabilities with the system.

If you've been following along with the patch notes, you'll know that this has been a major effort for us over the past months, so we're so excited to release the first playable version of it today and see what you'll do with it.

From your Steam Library you can now access the [b]Saleblazers Dedicated Server from the Tools section of your Steam Library or through installing it on SteamCMD[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/465fed22913acd0d28e0387422d9f8fbc7e61c8c.png[/img]

You can read all about [b]how to set up the Dedicated Server Console and see examples of how to use it in this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385724580]Guide[/url].[/b] ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385724580]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3385724580[/url])

This initial version of the tool is for Windows. If you want to host a dedicated server from Linux or Mac, you can use a virtual machine to do so.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b4b60f5a532829b2a037b4e479186bf2da060469.png[/img]

Using this tool, you can host persistent servers for yourself or your friend group, which we know has been a major request since before we even released in Early Access.

We also built in various player permission settings to configure and some other fun options like randomized spawning,  which can add a lot of variety to servers and enable better public servers.
As we improve these features for dedicated servers, we also plan on bringing them to traditional lobbies.

There are still some more features we're working on to improve dedicated servers, and there could be potential instabilities with the system, which is why this is still just the beta version of the tool.

But fortunately, that means you can also have a say in what the tool can do! We've opened up a new [b]#dedicated-server-feedback-forum[/b] channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/sapTNUNYR3]Discord[/url] to get feedback and suggestions about dedicated servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/321a4683ec79b0b6e11e3310fc225a864e17484b.png[/img]

If you all like hosting servers and want to see more variety for public servers, we're hoping to continue developing customization features for servers, maybe even introducing more varied game modes to host.

Try hosting a server or joining one, and let us know what you think!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.14.9.3
notes.notes:
[b]Patch v14.9.3 is live again![/b]

We appreciate your patience while we resolved the save issue initially in this patch.

In an effort to fix an error with the autosave we unfortunately introduced a new issue where if an autosave triggered the moment your shop unloaded, your shop save was severely damaged.

Thanks to everyone who reported this save issue as well as the other issues fixed in this patch and who have been making suggestions in game, on [url=https://discord.gg/sapTNUNYR3]Discord[/url], and on the Steam forums. We read all of your posts and do our best to respond where we can.

notes.title: Friends & Foes - Patch 14.9
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers! Happy 2025!

We hope you all had a good end to last year and are starting with an even better 2025!
We took some time to rest and are excited to be back with another update.

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Quest NPCs will now come to your shop
[*] Outposts can now send raids after you clear them
[*] You can now ping enemies remaining in an outpost one by one
[*] More outposts now feature rewards for clearing them
[/list]

[h1]Quest NPC Customers (Friends)[/h1]
Once you complete quests for various NPCs, they can appear at your shop as customers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a661a0ceb4722f8da3a111a3bb424a4982c461ad.png[/img]

These special customers have additional patience for your shop and some fairly large wallet sizes, so accumulating them should give you a small but welcome boost to the quality of your clientele.

Not every quest NPC can be a customer yet, but most NPCs associated with the main quest can. A few of our favorites from side quests will show up, too.

We plan on adding this functionality to more NPCs, so if you have a favorite character you want to see at your shop, let us know!

The NPCs available in this update are:
[list]
[*] [spoiler]Tayada[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Mayor Yori[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Captain Latch[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Andrei Barnaby[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Aiden Kingsmithy[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Jones Fishingman[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Freda McQuillan[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Chef Pippo[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Ambrosia[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Cassandra Gale[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Samantha Cole[/spoiler]
[*] [spoiler]Senhi Hideta[/spoiler]
[/list]

This was one of our earlier ideas when we started implementing the main quest into the game.
For various reasons, it didn't make it into the build until now, but we think it adds a nice connection between the story and your shop progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4b164c3baf46f47e0ebe4f469b2a0e4616315235.jpg[/img]

If you have already completed the associated quest for these characters, they should unlock automatically when you load your save on this update and start showing up at your store.


[h2]Quest NPC Customer Invites[/h2]
Right now, these special customers can be a bit rare to spawn, but you can change that by asking them to come to your shop!

Once you complete the associated quest for these characters, most will have a dialogue option where you can invite them to your shop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/656cc7efd691ff3039e95e8a4f83b2c398d82496.gif[/img]

Once you do, they will show up at the next shop you go to (or choose from one of your shops if you have friends running them in multiplayer).

So if you're ever low on customers, or just want one of these characters to drop by your shop, head over to them and just ask!

[h1]Expansion For Outpost Raids (Foes)[/h1]

In update 14.4.0, we added an experimental feature where you could see your progress for clearing out enemy outposts, receive a reward when defeating all the enemies in the outpost, and see how long until the outpost was reinforced and refilled with enemies.

In that update, we only added this feature to 3 outposts so we could try out the feature and get feedback on it.
You all seem to really like that mechanic, and we do too! So, we decided to add it to this update.

[h3]Ping Remaining Enemy[/h3]
One of this mechanic's biggest shortcomings was not finding the last few enemies in the outpost to clear it.
To address that, we've added this ping button that will appear once you've cleared more than 60% of the outpost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/786d837c453304502e8919d5012b36dd994c1b16.gif[/img]

Pressing it will ping one of the remaining enemies so you can hunt them down.
To ping the next enemy, you have to wait until the previous one is dead and their body has despawned, so you probably can't just spam pings and kill enemies, but this should help direct you to the next group or straggling enemy if you get stuck.

[h3]Outpost Retaliation Raids[/h3]
We also added the ability for the enemy factions to attack you in retaliation for clearing their outposts.

Every outpost that shows clear progress and gives a reward for completing it has a percentage chance to have the faction who owns that outpost send a retaliatory raid.
The chance of a raid and the size of that raid depends on the size and strength of the outpost you clear.

If you trigger a raid, you will see this Raid Incoming tag under the outpost UI once you clear it and the reward is spawned.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7e0f0bb1de1e46f59ae3edc3fd9fc52ad00907aa.png[/img]

The raid will come after you in the next few hours in-game, so you can try to prepare wherever you are, or you can go back to your shop or base to hunker down behind some turrets and spikes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5d219aef73e66246101b78ddbb1eb3733db26b44.gif[/img]

Because this mechanic introduces additional attacks that can target you and your shop, we understand not everyone will want to play with it enabled. So turning off the [i]Peaceful Shop[/i] setting will completely disable these raids from spawning.

This setting was previously named [i]Peaceful Nights[/i] as it also turns off nighttime attacks from ghouls, but we renamed it this week for these new outpost raids as they can occur during the day.

[h3]New Outposts with Rewards for Clearing[/h3]
With these new additions to our outpost clearing mechanic, we have also added functionality to more outposts throughout the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f42b65645cef0ced07fabe6028cf667233ed4441.jpg[/img]

In addition to the 3 original outposts with the mechanic, we're adding 9 more outposts that track your clearing progress and provide rewards (and raids) when completed.

8 of these outposts are Outlaw controlled in the Wetlands. This area should be an even cooler place to adventure and fight with all the outposts concentrated around the environment.
We also added the functionality to the small Ronin outpost on the southern edge of the Shepherd Ruins, as new players commonly frequent it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4df6725e2efbe2cfe94af3e47446722cf896aa43.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy clearing these outposts, reaping the rewards, and fighting off the forces that the Outlaws and Ronin send after you for revenge!

[h1]Hold to Confirm Scrap All[/h1]
We introduced the scrap all button back in update 14.3.0 and have enjoyed being able to quickly scrap loot that we don't want.

However, the downside of this button is when it is pressed accidentally and ends up scrapping gear you actually do want, either in an enemy death box or in one of your own containers.

To help avoid this issue and give you all a little more peace of mind, we've introduced a hold to confirm functionality to this button.
You can either hold the button on the UI or the keybinding to scrap the contents of the container you're interacting with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b8e13ca2c57a2f37c9d54641440468ce5e603e8c.gif[/img]

We tried to dial in the timing so it doesn't slow down quick looting too much but will still give you enough time to stop pressing it if you hit it by mistake.

We made this feature live earlier this week alongside some of the more pressing code fixes in the full patch notes below, so you may have already tried it!

[h1]Prologue Lighting Updates[/h1]
The prologue is the first impression of the game for a lot of players, so we're continually working to improve it and ensure players are smoothly introduced to Saleblazers.

Over the past couple of weeks, we've been working on overhauling the lighting in the prologue level to look nicer, better match the open world, and perform better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/70e2d31e55e20597c8d9c0dfcd43ae4cd0e69e36.png[/img]


[h1]Community Corner[/h1]
In patch v0.14.8.15, we introduced the long-awaited cosmetic slot options so you can equip something stylish without sacrificing the stats of the gear underneath.

We asked to see some of your character creations using this feature on our Discord, and it's been great to see everyone's outfits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/524339e0dcd93c2e8811c65da3bc676e17e7b764.png[/img]
From left to right, we have characters from Sei, KatVet, eaglescout, and Recette.

if you have a cool character you want to show off, please post it in the #characters showcase channel in the Discord. Thanks everyone for sharing!

[h3]New Community Loading Screen Tips[/h3]
We've got a few new loading screen tips to add to this update. Take note of the knowledge they bring!

[list]
[*] Wanna run faster? Equip a pocket knife and drink some coffee! -Anonymous
[*] Stay curious. There might be a rune behind the waterfall. -Anonymous
[*] Dress up with the cosmetic slots! No one knows there is full body armor under your apron. -Anonymous
[/list]

We also have one more new loading screen tip inspired by some players on Discord, but that is coming as a slightly more official tip.
[list]
[*] You can place single items from an equipped stack in your hotbar.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who shared loading screen tips and to everyone who is active on our official Discord, giving feedback, grouping up, and discussing the game.

notes.title: Threads of Authority - Patch 14.8.15
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!

We're very excited to be bringing you some immersion improvements, a better police wave system, and more quality-of-life improvements, including some highly requested features like alternate cosmetic slot overrides!

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cosmetic Slot Overrides
[*] Police System Overhaul
[*] Option to Allow Customers in Plot
[*] Immersion Improvements to the Dialogue System
[/list]

Saleblazers is also a part of the Steam Winter Sale which is going on now until Jan 2 at 10 AM PST. So now is a great time to hop in with a friend or two!

[h1]New Steam Capsule Art[/h1]
The lighting changes we made in update 14.8 have been well received, and we're enjoying them too.

We decided to introduce some updated Steam capsule art to reflect the game's improved look and hone in a little more on the shopkeeping aspects of the game experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7ecb67b013ec1500c7fc41b341224921ad62f54f.png[/img]

[h1]Cosmetic Equipment Slots[/h1]
Also, based on overwhelming player feedback, you can now adjust your appearance separately from your actual equipment.

If you've always wanted to look a certain way while retaining stats from another set of clothing, this is now possible!

You can access these new cosmetic equipment slots by clicking on the eyeball icon above the equipment slots in your inventory menu. A filled Ink Dye icon indicates that the cosmetic slot is active and will override the actual equipment slot.

This will let you not only override an item with another item but also override an item with nothing so you can get the stats from a mask, helmet or jacket without actually looking like you're wearing that item.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c7e25ee7e911c15a6cb54b6f63da1d178dcc18f0.png[/img]

In this example, only the hat and jacket slots will be overridden, resulting in a final look of a Samurai Hat with no jacket. Keep in mind that their actual stats will not be applied.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b8f003405bac44b4ff60672fc03fd62d66c5c069.png[/img]

We hope you'll all have plenty of fun with this feature and are excited to see your outfits! Put on some sweet threads!

[h1]Police System Overhaul[/h1]
We heard that the police system left much to be desired and agreed with that. 

As a first step towards making this system more fun we've cleaned up some of its inconsistencies, reworked the spawning logic for the Police AI, and created new waves of Police to face off against.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4278152b283ea2ec07e7d34235c360a8dcd082f0.png[/img]

These changes should make dealing with the Police more challenging and more fun!
[list]
[*] Added 2 new tiers of police troops, for a total of 4 tiers
[*] Police will now use ranged weapons more often and more effectively.
[*] Police equipped with higher-tier weapons will now always use them instead of sometimes switching back to a baton. This will mean to get an M4 from the Police, you'll have to actually fight an officer wielding an M4 instead of finding one in the death box of an officer wielding a baton.
[*] Police can now spawn in a radius around the player instead of from fixed locations
[*] You can now speak to patrolling Police to pay your bounty if you have one
[*] Updated the look of the Police to differentiate different tiers of officers better
[*] Balanced police HP and weapons
[*] Balanced the wave spawning for Police
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f032cc6e2564add3498e1ef1bd55b3aad1f09d4f.png[/img]

We've been having a lot more fun trying to fight back against the officers trying to bring us to justice and have been finding it a lot more challenging to survive.
This has also made clean crimes where you don't get caught more rewarding, and running away from the law a more enticing option.

[h1]Allow Customers in Plot Option[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/dbdfa54dfcadd33f8d8a8969525aee86b0aeb9b9.png[/img]

Based on player feedback, we've added a new option for when your shop is closed to not allow customers to enter your plot at all. 

We hope this can introduce a new level of calmness by stopping customers from constantly leaving trash at your shop's doorstep when you're remodeling or doing other activities in your shop and planning on having it closed for a while.

[h1]Improved Dialogue Effects[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f5ed89888226e7d15df5b49f3a2b640d5b933921.gif[/img]

We've also added some experimental text sound effects and camera head tracking to dialogue for increased immersion. So far, this has made talking to NPCs more engaging and satisfying. Let us know what you think!

[h1]Dedicated Server Backend Inclusions[/h1]
This update contains a lot of backend support for dedicated server features. 
You shouldn't notice anything different in your normal lobbies, but this patch is helping us gear up to release the beta version of our dedicated server console. 

We have found some tricky edge cases with some of the features, so we're working hard to smooth those out before we make the console available.

Here's a preview of some of the things you can do with the system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/321a4683ec79b0b6e11e3310fc225a864e17484b.png[/img]

We're very excited!

[h1]v0.14.8.15 Patch Notes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1e7a0db09a8b8ba8308d966bac5b5a62f4f37e0e.png[/img]

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a cosmetics equipment slot feature
[*] Added "Allow Customers in Plot" option to shop sign

[*] Customers will no longer close doors that you have manually opened, based on QoL player feedback
[*] Added quest marker to the Snowville trenches keycard quest for better accessibility
[*] Added a new option to prevent customers from coming into the shop plot if the store is closed, based on player QoL feedback
[*] Rebalanced and added more (difficult) types of NPC police based on player feedback
[*] Police now spawn in non-fixed locations similar to night enemies

[*] Camera now looks at NPC heads during dialogue to avoid scenarios where the NPC can be out of frame
[*] Dialogue text now plays text audio that is unique to each character
[*] Paper trash can now be turned into charcoal at the kiln to better automate crafting with trash with employees
[*] Adjusted chat and shop sign audio to be more peaceful
[*] Employees can now craft using items located in trash cans - this should help with automating your recyclers
[*] Shop simulations while you're away are slightly more accurate
[*] Loading into the shop via teleportation will now wait for the shop simulation to finish completely, preventing some lag spikes when teleporting to an automated shop

[*] Fixed a case that could cause items to fall out of chests in your shop plot

[*] Possibly fixed another case of getting stuck at the register
[*] Fixed Senhi, Mayor Yori's assistant, sometimes saying she was busy instead of playing her dialogue as intended
[*] Fixed an exception that could occur when equipping Airstrafer Sunglasses
[*] Adjusted Small Candelabra LODs to be more accurate

[*] Customers and employees during shop simulation should appear less frequently on top of items

[/list]

[h3]📜 Known Issues[/h3]

These should now be resolved in hotfix v0.14.8.16. Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Navigation Update - Patch 14.8
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!

We're incredibly excited to be bringing you this update today.

It addresses multiple features that many of you have suggested would improve the experience of exploring the Island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/cc68dfc0387b5f9b5f0096a7e6723f4eb735df1b.png[/img]

We also know performance has continued to be a source of feedback, so we spent some significant time on this update profiling, investigating, and implementing some new performance improvements. These performance improvements should make the experience of navigating the Island smoother and and more enjoyable!

We really hope you appreciate everything in this patch, and we look forward to hearing future suggestions!

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Compass Items
[*] Custom Map Markers
[*] New Mini Map Item
[*] Quest Indicators Above NPCs
[*] Dialogue Listening In for Multiplayer
[*] NPC Shop Bulk Purchasing
[*] Major Improvements to Performance and Hitching
[*] Melee Accuracy QoL Improvement
[/list]

[h2]Compass Items[/h2]
We know this has been a major request from a lot of you.
So, we're happy to be adding Basic and Advanced Compass items today! You can research how to craft the Basic Compass in the Research Board, and it will show you which direction you're looking, as well as the quest marker for your current tracked quest when you hold it or equip it as an accessory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/51b2521705897b6f0792018ef1883e1dd6964232.gif[/img]

You can learn the Advanced Compass recipe from[spoiler]Captain Latch[/spoiler]by completing the quest he gives you. If you've already completed this quest, you should have the recipe unlocked when you load your save.

The Advanced Compass shows the direction and quest like the basic compass, but it also shows you the locations of other players in co-op, nearby deathbox locations, and where your custom map markers are.

[h2]Mini Map Items[/h2]
In addition to the Basic Compass, you can research the Portable Map on the Research Board which will let you craft a small map that you can equip and hold in your hotbar to view a mini map while adventuring.

The downside of the Portable Map is you can't use any other weapons while you have it out. But remember, in Saleblazers, everything is a weapon, so if you get surprised by some unfriendly Ronin, you can slap them around with the map itself instead of pulling out a different weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/bfc258573d636e877c76a492d80e99f909056ca8.gif[/img]

The Portable Map Glasses have you covered if you want to equip a minimap without impeding your hands or hotbar.

These advanced shades are hard to get, though. You'll have to complete[spoiler]Andrei Barnaby's [/spoiler]quest in[spoiler]Snowville[/spoiler]to learn the recipe. Again, if you've already completed this quest, you should automatically unlock this recipe when you load your save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/662a5017a7d88cdaf9ce21c298fb09a4da3aa880.png[/img]

[h2]Custom Map Markers[/h2]
Another new feature to make navigating the Island easier are custom map markers! You can now double click on the map to place a marker and add a name for it.

These markers will save until you right-click on them to clear them. They should allow you to mark resource locations, enemy outposts, runes you want to bring your friends to later, or whatever else you'd like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/54fc8a9e84c9de06e1e9a06c8d5baf1466a6c4ab.gif[/img]

Plus, if you have an Advanced Compass, you can easily navigate with these markers without opening the map again.

[h2]NPC Quest Indicators[/h2]
Another point of feedback we've heard is that some of you want to be able to identify important NPCs more easily.

We originally wanted to make the discovery of these NPCs more free form, having you talk to new people you come across to see what they need and rely on directions from other dialogue to guide you to the next NPC. 

But we understand that the game world is big, and there are a lot of NPCs around between the customers, other shopkeepers, and residents of the villages. So it can feel overwhelming talking to everyone and worrying that you might miss out on a quest. Because of that, we're introducing quest indicators above NPCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/49ae74c2513e933149be4dc01b16a541520ef835.png[/img]

These indicators will show you if the NPC has a new quest for you, if you're working on a quest for them already, or if you're ready to turn in a quest to them.

Quests that are part of the main storyline will be marked gold, while sidequests will have white icons.

[h1]NPC Shop Bulk Purchasing[/h1]
One of the biggest roadblocks for using NPC shops is the fact that you have to purchase items one by one.

This isn't so bad when you're buying one piece of armor, but if you're trying to stock up a lot of items to sell or craft with, this can be frustrating. So in this update, you can now set the number of items you want to purchase from the shop before you checkout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a978f3558a96289d9e048fe2b1b2b86f185ff142.gif[/img]

We're looking forward to seeing more runs to the market in Kazai Village or Snowville's main street as a way to stock your shop!

[h1]Additional Quality of Life Features[/h1]
We've been monitoring the Steam Forums, Reviews, Discord Channels, and the In-Game Report feature for any quality-of-life features and improvements you've requested. 

The compass, map markers, mini map, and NPC shop bulk purchasing were all top requests, but we're also bringing some smaller QoL features to help round out the minute-to-minute experience.

[h3]New Deposit All Items Button for Containers[/h3]
This should help you drop off your stuff between adventures and get you back in action more quickly. In addition to our other recent inventory improvements, you can now deposit your entire inventory (or as much of it that will fit) into a container at the click of a button.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/bf6cb732d3958c209d0101d59b164053a25e42c5.gif[/img]

This will never move the items in your hotbar, so you can keep them with you for the next adventure.

[h3]New Size Filters for Employees in Container Options[/h3]
In a previous patch, we made employees more likely to look for containers of a matching size when restocking, but we heard that for some shop setups, this still wasn't enough, and it would be better to have more direct control.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/07da364f1e63b300cbed1967859dc79552e9457f.gif[/img]

Now you can set specific filters on your containers to only accept items of certain sizes for your employees.

[h3]Added Waist Light Toggle Button and Key Bind[/h3]
We know a lot of you use the waist light and don't want to go through the hassle of unequipping it during the day.

Now you can turn it on and off with a hotkey! The default binding is H, but you can change this in the Gameplay settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9e9b0ad3fe60517a5b72d69a3700fda40044b9b0.gif[/img]

[h3]Droppable Pickup Range Now Ignores Height[/h3]
When you're rebuilding a section of a structure on a higher floor, particularly roofs, it can sometimes be frustrating for the dismantled materials to fall down below you and have to climb down your structure to collect them while building.

Now, the spinning floating materials dropped from mining or dismantling can be picked up regardless of the height difference between you and them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/781c6fcbcbbd481ff566db4ec8ddf34e77470b44.gif[/img]

This will also help with any situations where people may have experienced a bug causing bamboo to get stuck in the air. Now you can run underneath it and collect it normally.

[h3]You Can Now Rename Save Files[/h3]
We heard a lot of stories of people who have built up a lot of save files and wanted a better way to organize them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a155ffd15b44d534bf48f59208a88a7c2a82371c.png[/img]

Now when you're in the load save file menu, you can press this edit button and change the name so you can more easily keep track of your different worlds.

[h1]Dialogue Listening In Feature for Multiplayer[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1a5c57742b8438dcbb3e5672bb39d70417a24bf0.gif[/img]

We hear that some players feel left out from private NPC conversations if another player engages with them, so in this patch we've added a new feature where you can see and hear other players' dialogues!

[h1]Combat Adjustments[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0a8f4a8a19db8bad543c8c44885dac3df80df7ee.gif[/img]

Based on overwhelming player feedback, we've improved melee targeting, removed mantle stamina cost, increased player bullet speed, and rebalanced NPC dodge rolling this patch.

Combat should now feel much more consistent and satisfying.

[h1]UI Banner Improvements[/h1]
The Minigame banner UI and the Shop VIP Wave Banner UI have been polished up and improved so they take up less of your screen and more seamlessly provide you with the information you need. 
They've also been updated to work better with ultrawide aspect ratios.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ed130df0832cf208d06e86ccca6d679e2897c94b.gif[/img]

[h1]Optimizations[/h1]
Improving game performance is a constant goal for us. We want to give you all the smoothest gameplay experience, and allow more players with lower end rigs to join us adventuring on the Island.

Over the past couple of weeks we've been pushing for some major optimization improvements and we're happy to be bringing you some significant updates today.

[h2][u]Standing Framerate Optimization[/u][/h2]
[h3]Tree Optimizations[/h3]
We identified that our tree models and shaders were heavier than necessary and were also not effectively using levels of detail meshes and billboards. We went through every tree and greatly optimized it at all distances, improving the impact of its level of detail meshes and billboards.

We also optimized our tree instancing so that trees farther away from you are not loaded at all which further saves performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1d57dbf1541d107a94e9540fb63f499eff2b9fc6.png[/img]

Finally, we also improved the serialization for saving trees, which will reduce your save file size.

[h3]Introduced Cave Chunk Loading[/h3]
Prior to this update, caves were loaded as part of the normal chunks of the world that are loaded when you get to them. 

However, some of our cave systems are quite large, and it isn't necessary to load all of that data while you're still above ground. So, we added load zones at the entrances to every cave that load and unload the cave areas so they are only loaded when you actually need them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/812121c6eca5dc15848c194425a7b9bb5079da8e.gif[/img]

[h3]Improved VFX Spawning Logic[/h3]
This improvement will help anyone spawning a lot of particles and other VFX throughout a play session. 

These effects will now spawn more efficiently, be grouped more efficiently, and despawn more appropriately, eliminating cases where VFX costs could add up over time.

[h3]Optimized Enemy Spawn Distances[/h3]
Enemies now spawn closer to you in a more intelligent way that reduces the number of enemies that are loaded but not visible to you.

[h3]Rig Optimization[/h3]
We went through the character rigs for all of our enemies and animals and optimized their bone structure to greatly reduce the impact they have when animating. 

We also optimized the distances where they fade in and out and added that fading functionality to player rigs for a boost in multiplayer.

[h2][u]Loading Hitch Reduction[/u][/h2]
One of the main performance pain points we identified was hitching, both major and micro, experienced while navigating the world. 

This was primarily due to loading in new chunks of the world as you explored. We implemented a number of features to address this hitching and have found significant improvements. While you might still notice a bit of a hitch when loading hub areas like Kazai Village, we found that many of the micro stutters and hitches have been eliminated, and the major ones have been reduced. To accomplish this, we did some of the following.

[h3]More Extensive Pre-Pooling[/h3]
We're now preloading more weapons, enemies, and NPCs so that they don't have to be loaded when you first encounter them. This moves that loading cost into the loading screen instead of occurring during gameplay.

[h3]Dynamic Object Spawning[/h3]
Some areas have many small props and objects inside of their respective chunks and because the world is divided into squares and loaded by section, entering a square with a high concentration of items could cause a hitch. 

Instead, all the small props and items are now loaded in a radius around the player which spreads this cost out so it's no longer concentrated to the few frames when you load a new chunk, reducing the hitching.

[h3]Dynamically Spawning Stationary NPCs[/h3]
Prior to this update, many of the stationary NPCs, often used for quests, were loading with the chunk of the map they occupied, adding to the cost of loading that area and contributing to the hitch. 

These NPCs are now dynamically spawned, similar to our enemies, so their cost is not concentrated on the frames when the area loads. They will still be in the same spots and should seem unchanged to you.

[h3]Hub Area Mesh Combine Optimization[/h3]
Specifically in the hub areas, we noticed a major cost was loading the large combined meshes that make up the buildings and floors in these zones. 

We went through these areas by hand and optimized a lot of their meshes to improve the loading times and reduce the hitch caused by loading them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/05c4ed778c8ec3eb4801cf0133e7e701d0bf0b7a.png[/img]

This optimization also has two other benefits in that these optimized meshes have a smaller memory footprint, and the way we divided them up allows for subsections of the zone to render at lower levels of detail while you're inside the hub, which wasn't the case before, improving the standing framerate in these areas.

[h3]Improved Multithreading Implementation[/h3]
We offloaded more operations to other threads and improved our use of other threads, in general, to vastly reduce the impact that various load operations had on second-to-second gameplay.

[h3]Improved Single Thread Load Times[/h3]
One of our test rigs has limited thread support and we noticed that where higher end rigs saw major improvements after our multithreading optimizations, this rig was falling behind. 
To address that, we added some logic to better distribute many of the load operations over more frames which should reduce their contribution to loading hitches.

[h3]Improved Addressable Streaming Logic[/h3]
We updated the system that streams textures when you load new items, particularly clothing and pickupable items. This will reduce the disk read-write cost when loading new areas. Playing on an SSD will still have a noticeable improvement over an HDD, though.

[h2][u]Memory Optimization[/u][/h2]
The memory improvements are made up of a much higher number of smaller impact improvements, so I won't get into calling them out one by one, but you should see some initially lower memory usage, and the usage over time should not grow unsustainably. 

We improved our use of texture atlasing and compression to get the most out of everything we're saving to memory, fixed some areas where memory could grow over long play sessions, and removed a lot of unnecessary items from memory.

The lower memory footprint should also improve your overall performance, especially if you were using most of your system memory before this update.

[h2][u]Optimization Results[/u][/h2]
Based on our testing, you should see a [b]10% to 25% increase in frame rate[/b], a [b]0.5GB to 2GB reduction in RAM[/b] usage depending on the scenario, and a [b]major reduction in loading hitches[/b] while exploring.

Many of the optimizations will help with performance in general, but for the area-specific optimizations, we did focus on all of the hub cities and the area around Pop Pop's Shop Plot, so you should see the largest improvements there.

We ran comparison tests on a variety of systems, but of course our testing sample size is much smaller than the breadth of systems the community as a whole is using.
If you'd like to share the performance details after this patch with us, feel free to make a post on our Discord! We'd love to hear about it and maybe we can find other areas to improve performance.

Using the data from our latest performance tests, we have adjusted the minimum system requirements on the Steam page and added recommended system requirements.

We will continue to keep an eye on performance and include improvements in future updates.


[h1]Czech and Danish Language Support[/h1]
It was brought to our attention that while we added support for Czech and Danish in a previous patch, there was a bug that prevented users from properly accessing these language options.

This has now been fixed so for anyone hoping to play in Czech or Danish, you should be able to with ease now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ff423d461f2807fdbf34dadaea44a14199076921.png[/img]

As always, please let us know if you have any issues with language support for any language and we will make sure to address it as soon as possible.

[h1]Update on Dedicated Servers[/h1]
We decided to switch gears to work on this patch's performance optimization and quality of life features based on player feedback. 

Since this patch is now complete, we'll return to work on releasing our Saleblazers Dedicated Server. It's in its final testing phase, so hopefully it won't be too long before it's available!

[h1]Community Corner[/h1]
[h3]New Community Advice[/h3]
[list]
[*]"Just before you fall to the ground from a height, dash to avoid being damaged." - Kirin
[*] "Telemed doesn't know about the money you have stashed away. Avoid rebirth fees by storing your earnings before adventuring." - Anonymous
[/list]
Shoutout to Kirin for this tip! If you have a tip that you want to submit to add to the loading screens in game, make sure to share it in the #loading-screen-tips channel on our Discord!

[h3]Community Creations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c4808304c4d83fbb2b8e6b4fc70388acbd48a248.png[/img]
This incredible mountain house shop on the Smithrock shop plot was built and shared by user 10cat on the Discord. We really liked seeing the detail and the creative use of beams and props. The vibes are really great here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/06f99c83af6f1abaa89636423154173306e33d3c.png[/img]
User KatVet shared this amazing 3D print they designed, printed, and painted of a lovely Bellcoat.

We think this is so cool and thought you all might too. KatVet even shared a link to the STL file they created so anyone could download and print it for free themselves if they wanted to!

If you have some cool builds, outfits, or anything Saleblazers related that you want to share with the us and the rest of the community, definitely post it in the #share-your-creations channel in our Discord.

Maybe we can even showcase it in future patch notes!

[h1]v0.14.8 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/38f04b2ecd98f50c075e42489b5c59fdbf45a5e7.png[/img]

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added basic and advanced compass items
[*] Added minimap item
[*] Added minimap glasses item
[*] Added custom map marker feature
[*] Added NPC quest markers feature
[*] Added the ability to purchase items in bulk at NPC shops
[*] Increased melee lunge speed
[*] Increased melee lunge max distance
[*] Damaging an enemy no longer disables lunging, to allow the player to keep up better with the enemy
[*] Lunge is more accurate now
[*] Melee lunge now sets your rotation to face the enemy better
[*] Bullets shot by the player are now 100% faster for more fun gunplay
[*] Increased Katana move cancel timing
[*] Increased dash impulse and removed dash invincibility frames for all NPCs (except bosses) to improve combat experience
[*] Aiming down sights, walking, and crouching are no longer allowed while gliding
[*] Readjusted global lighting to have better visibility in general outside midnight hours
[*] Heavy attacks now have uniform charge times between 0.2 and 0.8 and thus are much quicker to release in general
[*] Large box heavy attack slowed down to compensate for faster charge time
[*] Shop VIP wave UI now shrinks after the initial large display
[*] Chat sender names are bolded and yellow for better visibility
[*] When a player engages in a private conversation with an NPC, subtitle text will display and audio will play for nearby players so that everyone can listen in
[*] Mantling no longer has a stamina cost since NPCs can now properly chase you when mantling
[*] Reduced the HP for boars in the starting area
[*] Reduced the knockback for the boar's charge attack
[*] Slightly re-terraformed the hill past the Shepherd ruins on the way to Kazai Village to reduce terrain seams
[*] Zena now drops two special weapons at various rarities
[*] Reduced durability damage on all shotguns
[*] You can now enter the small uninteractable sheds in Kazai Castle. There may be some small rewards there

[*] Dropkick attack now has a lower base damage but will scale significantly better with vertical distance travelled
[*] Dropkick attack now holds until landing

[*] Employee filters now always work for items that fulfill all of the category and size filters, or the item filter "whitelist"
[*] The sort inventory button is now slightly larger to make it easier to press
[*] Added a mini map and compass to the main menu

[*] Repositioned and enlarged interaction prompt UI

[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Moved expensive nav mesh chunk calculations off the main thread, which should reduce hitching when traveling
[*] Improved pre-pooled enemies, weapons, and NPCs to reduce hitching. You may experience slightly longer initial loading phase
[*] Optimized tree meshes for lower rendering costs
[*] Created new LOD meshes for all trees to improve performance for rendering trees at a distance
[*] Improved tree data serialization to reduce save file size and improve loading speed
[*] Improved tree billboarding in the distance
[*] Reduced shadow distance and optimized shadow resolutions
[*] Converted most preplaced objects into a distance spawner that will load them in within a radius around the player instead of in discrete chunks
[*] Massively reduced combined meshes file sizes in hub areas
[*] Converted many quest NPCs to be spawned in instead of preplaced in the level
[*] Removed extraneous variables on dash code for less memory usage
[*] Reduced expensive operations on streamed assets (materials, scenes), which should reduce hitching when traveling
[*] Distributed scene chunk load across more frames, which should reduce hitching when traveling
[*] Addressed reasons why meshes were sometimes not batching properly which reduces the number of draw calls
[*] Improved player and character mesh LOD functionality
[*] Optimized most character rigs and animation tick rates for better performance
[*] Better split up the floor and building meshes in Kazai Village so we can LOD out farther away parts of the village more accurately
[*] Removed many extraneous objects from the scene that were no longer required
[*] Set up cave loaders that load and unload most caves when you enter and exit them so they no longer have to be loaded when in the open world
[*] Optimized some static meshes that are used in hub areas
[*] Removed duplicate meshes in hub areas
[*] Fixed lag hitch when first seeing dying UI
[*] Optimized enemy spawn distances
[*] Improved addressable material streaming logic
[*] Improved VFX spawning logic
[*] Optimized spawners in the prologue
[*] Reduced number of draw calls in the prologue
[*] Reduced the density of some NPCs in the prologue
[*] Reduced tick rate of non-demanding AI behavior trees
[*] Removed many unused spawners across the map
[*] Removed unused map references to improve memory usage
[*] Compressed terrain proxy atlas texture to improve memory usage
[*] Disabled AI body part combining to prevent memory consumption when visiting hubs
[*] Optimized visibility and spawner code to use less memory
[*] Compressed and improved atlasing for terrain detail textures to prevent memory from growing as much during long explorations
[*] Improved shader caching to reduce load times
[*] Optimized lag when opening the map
[*] Removed lag when pinging on the map
[*] Greatly optimized how AI clothing is rendered on bodies to reduce memory usage for stored body meshes
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ Stability Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed various animation and logic issues with gliding in combination with crouch, walk, and jog states

This issue does not occur on the Advanced Compass. Clearing these other markers should fix the issue until a hotfix is ready[/strike]

We have not found a consistent way to reproduce this so if this happens to you please let us know on Discord, the Steam Forums, or the in-game report function[/strike]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/781349dd6e6e0b2fc2bae8e226ceafcbdeb781f6.png[/img]
Looking forward to seeing you for the next update! Thank you so much for playing Saleblazers.
