notes.title: Saleblazers 1st Year Anniversary - Update 14.7.48
notes.notes:
It's been an entire year since we launched [i]Saleblazers[/i] in Early Access! Thank you all so much for supporting the game so far. 🥳🥳🥳

We recently released our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1419850/view/6808965920888384275]Prologue Projections patch v0.14.7.41[/url], which brought many changes and new additions for you, but we still wanted to celebrate our anniversary with some additional content and improvements.

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] New Exclusive Cosmetics for 1st Year Supporters
[*] New Set of Building Pieces
[*] New Side Quest
[*] Some Visual Polish Improvements
[*] New Server Browser
[/list]
[h2]First Year Cosmetics[/h2]
Earlier this year we added our first cosmetic options for our early supporters. We wanted to add another badge of honor for everyone who has been a part of this first year of Saleblazers.

Players who have [b][i]Saleblazers[/i] in their library before October 7th 2024 at 10 AM Pacific[/b] will unlock a green money name tag and a green money color dye for the Tourist Hat.

[h3]Money Name Tag[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7108a174fd9cfe615c274f1889542aa1925419dd.png[/img]

This green nameplate will show everyone you play with or come across on the Island that you're a dedicated Shopkeeper and that you always have money on your mind.💰

You can cycle through your available name tags in the ESC menu. Plus, starting with this update, you can also cycle through them in the main menu to set up your name plate before joining a lobby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/51a903345c2b292a0e7c22e1e3f25b43afb2bcac.png[/img]

[b]Reminder: If you bought [i]Saleblazers[/i] before our first Steam sale in March, you should also have the golden Airstrafer name tag![/b]

[h3]Money Tourist Hat Dye[/h3]
With this update, you'll also unlock a new color dye option for the Tourist Hat. This can be selected in the main menu when you make a new character, and you can dye other Tourist Hats this color with a dye bench.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/25a673c83d7c7348ce86dd1a8d19bc6de044807a.png[/img]

This cash-green cap will help get you in the head space of making the most money every time you open your shop.

If you all enjoy these cosmetic flourishes, we're excited to continue adding more and see your character photos featuring these items!

[h2]New Western Building Set[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/acd1e36e34684749d373bda5666ae22e63f53389.gif[/img]

We know how much you all love to build and expand your houses and shops. So, what better to add for our one-year anniversary than a new set of building pieces?

These pieces are inspired by the architecture of Snowville and feature some nice wooden plank aesthetics for cozy homes, rugged cabins, and so much more.

This is one of the biggest building sets added to the game so far and it features some very unique pieces to use. Jordan, our designer, is especially fond of these tall windows with shutters and the saloon doors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9f0b22700b5ed695c8e2954e68632e293c5b1dc1.png[/img]

The set features brown wooden versions and rustic blue painted versions of the building pieces so you can accent with a pop of color or build a weathered structure to better fit the theme of your shop or house.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/571c9b44fdd5f9e9ce3b63c18266a6b1015485c7.gif[/img]

We also heard that some of our dedicated builders felt the wood structure options were a little bit sparse, so we hope this more than helps fill that void.

We're looking forward to seeing your builds using these pieces!

[h2]New Side Quest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5187e937e62f2eb11f230358addc9ec2c56af486.png[/img]
Thanks to some feedback from some players on Discord, we added a new side quest to help bring you all to Burke O'Hare, our resident Death Box recovery specialist.

Following this update, the first time you rebirth after arriving on the Island, you'll receive a communication from Burke telling you about his services and encouraging you to come to him to recover your Death Box.

[b]If you've already met Burke,[/b] this message will take the form of a reminder about using his recovery service.

From there, you can pay Burke to recover your Death Box and earn yourself some extra EXP and a Rune. We hope this will also help inform players about this mechanic so they know to use it if they ever have trouble getting back to their Death Box.

[h2]Reload Feedback Polish[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/833cd543c3493d114918e9f036c664ee732d8d54.gif[/img]

Some of the guns have unintuitive reload times, so we've added a reload timer indicator to the gun UI to add some QoL to ranged weaponry. No more will you have to spam shoot and hope you're done reloading towards the end of the animation.

[i](This may or may not have been inspired by a hero shooter recently.)[/i]

[h2]Zipline Mechanic Polish[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/75d4fd76aa5b4a01f60f5639746192f034569014.gif[/img]

Attaching to a Zipline will now stick your character to a spot underneath the line instead of leaving you at the same relative position. 

We did this to make the overall experience more comfortable and consistent. To complement this change, we've also modified the Zipline audio to sound more soothing. Check it out when you have the chance!

[h2]Updated Server Browser[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/dac689128bd7590c0c75c85a90286c6862dc848a.png[/img]
In preparation for our upcoming dedicated server patch, we've updated the join screen. 

You can see that in this screenshot dedicated servers will have a special icon!

We're planning on having some public server tests, so keep an eye out in the server browser list as well as https://discord.gg/Saleblazers.


[h1]v0.14.7.48 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7003c19ac5b992ba54055a5c2757669e8d0753c2.png[/img]

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added reload progress UI indicator
[*] Attaching to and traversing a zipline will now force the player to a fixed spot underneath the line
[*] Changed Zipline audio to be a little less aggressive
[*] Jumping off Ziplines now gives a large vertical boost
[*] Added new western style building pieces
[*] Added new side quest with Burke O'Hare
[*] Added new anniversary name tag plate
[*] Added new anniversary color dye option to the Tourist Hat
[*] Updated server browser list UI
[*] Added name plate style cycling to main menu
[*] Rebalanced research prices for building pieces
[/list]

[h3]⚙️ Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized droppable item pickup collision detection code
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare case where sometimes the player can fall through the terrain when a very specific collision sequence occurs (most noticeably when you lag)
[*] Fixed one case where if an exception occurred that it would cause async tasks to get stuck instead of complete
[*] Fixed bug where creating a new character could duplicate the clothes of your previous character due to leftover code from our upcoming Dedicated Server patch
[*] Fixed armor not giving the proper amount of armor when joining another server as client
[*] Fixed NPC armor values not updating properly for clients
[*] Request customers will always like their item, which can prevent weird negative reviews that sometimes occurred before
[*] Request customers will no longer say that they didn't find anything despite the player fulfilling their request
[*] Fixed a case where cutting down many trees close together would cause their resources to float in the air
[*] Fixed the clapping SFX in the prologue not adhering properly to player audio settings
[*] Fixed the spacing on the special name plate icons in the main menu and lobby menu UI
[*] Corrected some slightly offset colliders on the main stairs in the prologue atrium that could cause you to get a little bit stuck on the way up
[*] Corrected the cable machine description
[*] Fixed the crow egg item missing a mesh
[*] Fixed some cases where clients were unable to repair certain items that had upgraded durability
[*] Fixed various disconnects
[/list]

Thanks for an incredible year of [i]Saleblazers[/i]! Here's to the next one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/cf30ecb710ecef907a1909e56e29ea1e0715cee3.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.14.7.45
notes.notes:
This hotfix resolves some issues with player totems, revives, and fixes an issue introduced in the last hotfix where floating droppable items can't be picked up. 

Thank you to everyone who reported that for bringing it to our attention and for your patience while we resolved the issue. We apologize for the inconvenience.

[h1]v0.14.7.45 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Radiation, cold, fire, hunger, and thirst damage no longer prevent in progress revives from completing. This should help reduce the frustration when your friend dies inside of an environmental damage area or while you are starving as previously you would have a hard time reviving them without being interrupted. Enemy attacks still interrupt revives.
[*] Added a Discord button link (https://discord.gg/Saleblazers) to the main menu in preparation for the upcoming Steam store update where we will have to remove our store page's Discord image link
[*] Reduced audio levels for looping tutorial lights
[*] Added better crossbow reload animations
[*] Disabled Occlusion Culling option and instead dynamically set it based on game zone manually for best performance case
[/list]

[h3]⚙️Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized droppable floating resources so they no longer use colliders and run on another thread. This should improve performance when creating a lot of these items from farming or mining and should prevent crashes or falling through the floor when thousands of these items spawn at once
[*] Occlusion culling should now be enabled properly in the prologue, which should help with GPU rendering performance
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed player totems always showing that something is preventing you from teleporting to them
[*] Fixed players not being able to collect droppable floating resources
[*] Fixed a rare case where mantling or sliding on very angled surfaces could cause you to fall through the world terrain
[*] Fixed a case where players could not rejoin a lobby after being disconnected from it
[*] Fixed a case where the host would see the wrong character customization for clients in the lobby screen
[*] Fixed occlusion culling issues in prologue when resetting graphics settings in the prologue level
[/list]

notes.title: Prologue Projections - Update 14.7.41
notes.notes:
Hello Shopkeepers!

We have a new patch for you today that we're very excited to share. We hope it improves the early game experience and adds some highly requested things for all you experienced shopkeepers, along with lots of fixes, optimizations, and general improvements.

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major Improvements to the Prologue
[*] Major Upgrades to Building Snapping
[*] Improved Stealth Mechanics
[*] New Item Recipes and Research Board Unlocks
[*] Three New Side Quests
[*] Golf Cart Driving Animations
[*] Improved Japanese Translation
[/list]
We hope you enjoy it!

[h1]Prologue Additions[/h1]
In this patch we're bringing some more major improvements to the prologue. 

We want the experience of playing the prologue to better match the excitement and discovery in the rest of the game, so we've updated some rooms with that goal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/fc64fadf8f7ef4f4d015955747b84565bd6e113a.gif[/img]

You'll now find projections of different locations on the Island in the leap of faith and dodge rolling rooms. The dodge rolling room also received a complete visual overhaul. 

The blocking and parrying room has been redone to look better and improve the flow of players through it. The water type room received some visual improvements to make the water types more clear. The water material itself was redone to look better. And, there are more hidden items and things to find throughout now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4467e2b36ade0612de3f385b3791032dcd769fa6.gif[/img]

If you haven't played the prologue before or haven't seen it in a while, feel free to check it out on a new save. Hopefully, this will improve the experience for new players coming to the game.

[h1]Improved Building Snapping[/h1]
One of the biggest areas of improvement we've heard you want is making the building system more straightforward to use.

We agree and want the building to be as seamless and enjoyable as possible, so we reworked our snapping system for this patch. We're calling the new system [b]Quick Snap[/b].

[h2]Quick Snap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e0c425d16d7402cfc66fd5b3d83fbaf95960fb08.gif[/img]

The new snapping system should make it much easier to build downwards, which was a specific pain point with the old system. It also makes it easier to build by looking at where you want the piece to go instead of needing to look at the edge of the last piece to get it to snap.

[h2]Detailed Snapping Points (Hold Block)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7d4fc391c56b36d7fa608c39b011c7c710dc3196.gif[/img]

We added more snapping points to our larger building pieces like walls and doorways so you can more freely build off them. We didn't want these additional snapping points to get in the way of normal building, so [b]you can access these more detailed snapping points by holding block (right click) when building.[/b] This should open up the possibilities for a lot of different builds. 

Remember that you can always [b]ignore snapping completely by holding shift [/b]while building for total freedom.

[h2]Better Building Hologram Visibility[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f6f140ede2ce734dd4cb8394d14313ea53a9d31f.gif[/img]

We also increased the opacity of the placement hologram so you can better see where you're placing in all lighting conditions and more easily see the color of the hologram, which indicates the piece's integrity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5ecf6424dd770084680c1c49d3c632bbba68c939.gif[/img]

This should help reduce cases where your pieces break because you didn't realize they wouldn't have enough integrity since you couldn't see the hologram was red.

[h2]Quick Snap and Legacy Building Snapping Toggle Option[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c9acb72e4fb0b98595c74cdbd69d4ed33cd7ac99.gif[/img]

This new building system feels a bit different from the old one, and while we think it's a significant improvement, we realized that some of you might be used to the existing snapping and want to stick with it. 

So, if you would like to, you can [b]change between the Quick Snap and Legacy building snapping in the gameplay settings.[/b]

However, we highly recommend you give Quick Snap a try because it brings a lot of improvements. Quick Snap will be enabled by default.

[h1]Better Stealth Mechanics[/h1]
There has been a lot of player feedback on making stealth more viable, so we've been working on a few improvements.

Previously, you could already:
[list]
[*] Mask your footstep sounds from NPCs by holding crouch (C)
[*] Perform sneak attacks by hitting NPCs in the back while they're unaware for 2X damage
[/list]
In this patch, we've added a few more changes to hopefully make stealth gameplay more viable:
[list]
[*] Sneak attack damage increased from 2X to 5X damage
[*] The angle of hitting NPCs in the back for a sneak attack is now more forgiving
[*] Killing an enemy and hitting illegal items will no longer trigger hearing senses
[/list]
As well as some more improvements to NPC sensing:
[list]
[*] Reduced hearing range of Outlaws from 20m to 8m to bring them in line with other NPCs
[*] Shooting guns should properly alert nearby enemies (suppressed weapons are much quieter)
[*] When an NPC engages an enemy, they will alert nearby allies of that enemy as well
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5e58319a734aba9f5e68b7f880642abc01b7d6aa.gif[/img]

In this GIF, you can observe that killing enemies silently in one hit keeps you undetected. We hope you enjoy these changes!

[h1]New Item Recipes and Research Tree Unlocks[/h1]
We've added a few more recipes to the Research Tree for some extra shop stock and decoration options!

[h2]Sports and Fitness Items[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f1ad2c36b9b1fcd7da9a5d4f88b9d8baf3135dcd.png[/img]
We heard that one of the more confusing star promotion VIP waves was when your shop filled with Athlete customers because there was not a straightforward way to craft your own Sports and Fitness items. 

To help you overcome this challenge and unlock the ability to run a Sports or Fitness-themed shop, we've added 3 new nodes to the research board where you can unlock sports balls, other sports equipment, and exercise equipment.

[h2]Rustic Logs Benches and Stump Chairs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2b58f0717d488e4b5f6c1661d3795f4ca42965dc.png[/img]
To go with the grass floors added in the last patch, we've added item functionality to these pine logs and stumps that you could previously find out in the world but not pick up. Now, you can collect and craft them to decorate your outdoor areas or help fill in a woodsy-themed shop.

The prices for all these items have also been rebalanced with their new recipes in mind.

[h1]New Side Quests[/h1]

[h2]Kazai Village Blockade NPC Quest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0f851f8244ada6b1a3c2104c7cbbf49dbd35b118.png[/img]
[i]Can you help reunite Eddie with his girlfriend?[/i]

This patch introduces a new quest intended to take early-game players who are hanging around Pop Pop's shop on a little adventure to Kazai Village and into conflict with the Ronin.

As a reward, you'll unlock a new decoration item we think many of you will enjoy selling, using to decorate your shop, or beating people with.

If you've already completed Mayor Yori's quests, this side quest will be a little bit shortened because the Ronin presence has already been reduced. But you can still get the rewards, and you can load up a new save with a friend to try out the quest in its entirety.

[h2]Bonsai Cherry Tree Shopkeeper and Quest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2b0771817ff28e453c807d1003cf8ad4ae1b42f8.png[/img]
By popular request, we also introduced Farr Lind, a bonsai artist who will sell you bonsai cherry tree decorations near the Dojo Shop Plot. She also has a small quest where you can finally unlock the recipe to craft these beautiful little trees.

[h2]Guillotine Side Quest[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8b2cac38513a5fc3b66dfc51cdddc415a428f419.png[/img]
You can now find Tobias Stint in the Kazai Castle Settlement beside a currently inoperable guillotine. Tobias wants to restore the guillotine and marvel at its engineering beauty. You can help him and unlock a special craftable reward in this new quest.

[h1]New Golf Cart Driving Animations[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/3334949d3536fcbc96c61c30ef83c2a24866b80e.gif[/img]

We've added all-new animations for driving the Golf Cart! Gone are the days of telepathic driving.

[h1]Fidelity FX 1.0 Performance Changes[/h1]
Enabling FidelityFX 1.0 upscaling in the video settings will now automatically apply a 0.15 reduction in render scale for better GPU performance.

We've also enabled FidelityFX 1.0 upscaling by default for all graphics settings other than Ultra to hopefully provide a nice GPU boost for lower end PCs. If you want the look of the game from before, just set Upscaling to Normal with Render Scale at 1.0!

[h1]Improved Japanese Translation[/h1]
We heard a lot of feedback that the Japanese translation in Saleblazers was lacking in a few ways, so we spent some time refining it and making various improvements. It's still not on the same level as our Spanish and Chinese translations, but we've observed significant improvements so we hope it improves the experience for anyone playing in Japanese.

This is also a reminder that if you see any issues or areas for improvement in the translation for the language you play in, please let us know on Discord or in the Steam forums, and we will work on improving it.

[h1]Dedicated Server Progress[/h1]
You'll be able to connect directly to dedicated servers via an IP address, so we've added that option to the join button this patch. It's mostly designed for dedicated servers, which have yet to be released. You shouldn't be using this feature unless you're trying to connect to a dedicated server.

If you want up-to-date news, join https://discord.gg/Saleblazers, where we might even have public dedicated server tests!

[h1]v0.14.7.41 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/87a9d16f64ff2977587571563d06679e6f15c257.gif[/img]
[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added significant polish and narrative elements to many sections of the prologue tutorial areas
[*] Overhauled the visuals for the water in the prologue
[*] Removed some extraneous signage from the prologue
[*] Rearranged some teleportation totems from the prologue for better flow and checkpointing
[*] Added runner and swimmer NPCs to the prologue
[*] Added Eddie Odtree encounter and quest to the road near the starting area
[*] Added a new decor item and NPC shopkeeper related to Eddie Odtree's quest
[*] Added Farr Lind NPC shopkeeper near the Dojo Shop Plot who sells Cherry Blossom Bonsai Trees
[*] Added a small quest to Farr Lind to learn the recipe for Cherry Blossom Bonsai Trees
[*] Added Tobias Stint to the Kazai Castle Settlement with a side quest
[*] Added a new special craftable item as a reward for Tobias' quest
[*] Added Sports Balls, Sports Equipment, and Weight Equipment nodes to the research tree
[*] Created crafting recipes for the barbell, dumbbell, dumbbell rack, squat rack, cable machine, jumping box, soccer ball, basketball, golf ball, yoga ball, golf club, and baseball bat items
[*] Updated base item values for sports items
[*] Added the overhauled Quick Snap building system
[*] Added detailed building snapping points to walls, windows, and doorways that can be accessed while blocking when building
[*] Added a shopkeeper to the shop north of the Snowed Inn
[*] Removed some deprecated prefabs from a building in Snowville
[*] Added backup dialogue to Chef Pippo to get the baguette recipe again if it doesn't unlock properly the first time
[*] The steering wheel of the golf cart now turns when you steer
[*] Added player driving animations for the golf cart
[*] Improved player look IK when sitting on chairs to avoid arms clipping through the body
[*] Getting hit with a melee attack will now unseat you from chairs (and the Golf Cart)
[*] Added game zone UI for the smithrock and southern snow shop plots
[*] Smoothed Golf Cart steering replication for better aesthetics
[*] Hitting explosives now fears all NPCs in line of sight and within 2m hearing radius
[*] Enemies who are killed with an attack will only trigger sight senses instead of both sight and hearing
[*] Increased sneak attack damage modifier from 2X to 5X
[*] Cowboys have a hearing radius of 8.21m instead of 20m
[*] NPCs will now perform a line of sight check on the player instead of the item when an item is hit
[*] Shooting guns will now properly aggro nearby enemies, with suppressed weapons having less impact
[*] Small pole (knife) heavy attack hitbox starting time is now earlier to make stealth kills easier
[*] Enemies will alert nearby enemies within 8 units when initiating combat
[*] Added a direct IP join option in preparation for dedicated servers
[*] Dedicated servers will show their IP address in the join lobby view
[*] Adjusted the kill boxes for the death pits near the Proving Grounds to allow for more creative building solutions
[*] Greatly improved Japanese translations
[*] Changed held position for the Yoga Mat
[*] Added Rustic Log Bench and Rustic Stump Chair items to the Research Tree
[*] Adjusted names, descriptions, item value, held position, interactables, LODs, and crafting recipes for Rustic Log Bench and Rustic Stump Chair
[*] Added spellbook specialty category to shops (previously you had to set your shop to the ranged weapon category)
[*] Buffed the Burst Fire Revolver special weapon and updated its name and description
[*] Interacting with a Totem will now play much less dialogue after you have unlocked 1 Totem
[*] Free Totems will now automatically unlock when interacted with
[*] Reduced the reload time for the laser crossbow
[*] Improved the logic that dictates where death boxes drop

notes.title: TinyTeams Festival 2024 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello shopkeepers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a7e6d123241fe9dac3f76a681fbaf9b2291ae1a2.png[/img]

[i]Saleblazers[/i] is a part of TinyTeams 2024! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2024]Check out the rest of the festival here.[/url]

In this update, we're bringing you some stability and optimization improvements as well as some general gameplay updates.

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved performance
[*] Better rain
[*] More robust backup save system
[*] Improved building safety standards in Kazai Village
[*] New grass path tiles
[*] News on Saleblazers Dedicated Server
[/list]
Happy Shopkeeping this weekend!

[h1]New Gameplay Trailer[/h1]
[previewyoutube=T8eqlnffAeE;full][/previewyoutube]
It's been almost a year since launch, so we've decided to make a new trailer for our Steam page to better communicate what the game will be like for new players.

Thank you to uRBAN_Spaceman for sending us your save file and allowing us to use your shop in the trailer.

It's a little more raw and less cinematic than our previous gameplay trailer. I hope you like it!

[h1]Grass Optimization and Visual Improvements[/h1]
The vertex count of grass has been dramatically reduced for better performance. In spite of this, grass also appears fuller due to shader and vertex changes for an overall visual improvement. The amount of grass throughout the game remains unchanged -- it just looks denser and runs faster.

[b]Notice how the grass in the red circle appears fuller.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a37578bf2c61c57a708dfb8a879eb4ed486578c8.png[/img]

We've seen some systems jump from 100 FPS to 110 FPS. It's a win-win scenario: better visuals and better performance!

[h1]Increased Rain Intensity[/h1]
We've always had physically calculated rain in the game, but it just wasn't very visible. Now it's a lot more pronounced when it's raining, which should make your shop feel a lot more cozy when you're indoors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f9f8a0b9ffb64f75d2cf8a2ae82c7a8fd347a6bd.gif[/img]

The particle has also been simplified a bit so that it's a little more performant.

[h1]Kazai Village Building Safety Improvements[/h1]
Our Summer intern, Brandon, has helped us smooth out the experience of navigating Kazai Village safely by adding some much-needed railings and ropes to the edges of the platforms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1738d8c3980a0b873f1aff2a719685ee87a77e2c.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e0e7f2d6fa7e9ae8881b366e74156bf18c5da033.png[/img]
These changes come along with a lot of collider fixes. This should improve how the collision matches up with the visuals and it reduces the overall number of colliders to improve performance. There are also a few added props and other visual improvements.

[h1]Backup Save Improvements[/h1]
This patch introduces a character save backup system that works alongside the World save backup system and a system for making multiple backup saves and choosing which one to load.

In the event of a power outage or interruption in saving that would corrupt the character save process, you can load up your character backup by: 
[list]
[*] Going in game, navigating to the Help menu in the settings, and selecting Load Backup Save
[*] Renaming the character backup save file found at C:\Users\YOURPCNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Airstrafe Interactive\Saleblazers\Saves\YOURSTEAMID to the name of your character save
[/list]
As of this update, when you select Load Backup Save from the Help Menu, the game will prompt you to select which save you want to load from your last 3 backups. Based on the timestamps, you can gauge which one will recover the data you lost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/c0f29f34ac0d47e37366d3a6405c1a709a837d20.png[/img]
When you load a backup save from the Help Menu, your World and character will roll back to the older save, overwriting your current save. Backup saves are generated automatically whenever the game saves via autosave or exiting the game to the menu.

Clients can also now use the Load Backup button which will rollback their character inside of another player's lobby. This should resolve any issues where clients lose any inventory progress in multiplayer sessions.

[h1]Grass Path Tiles[/h1]
We heard you wanted more path options to customize your shops, especially when building outdoor spaces like courtyards. So, in this update, we added new grass path tiles, which you can research in the research board and then craft using plant fiber. We're excited to see what additions you make to your builds with these tiles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b44c496be1b1c663e46288aa9e4412a5094a3ef1.png[/img]

[h1]Dedicated Server Update[/h1]
We've gotten far enough in the dedicated server that we'll be pushing towards releasing this. 

In the coming weeks, we'll be testing it out internally and adding server role functionality so that you can host public lobbies with some safeguards against griefing.

[i]We hear you want a Linux server, but we're planning on working on the Windows version first. However, as with other dedicated servers, you should be able to run it with Proton or Wine.[/i]

[h1]v0.14.7.37 Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/262da2c27a72266ef4ba6a297e5016c4c87c8a61.png[/img]

notes.title: Summer Patch
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome Shopkeepers![/h2]
We hope you are having a nice and relaxing Summer. We have some exciting quality-of-life features for you this patch! A lot of these have been common requests from you, the community. Thank you so much for being a part of improving the game for everyone. We hope you enjoy the improvements in this update. We sure enjoyed making them and using them during testing so far. 

[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] Singleplayer Pausing
[*] Inventory Sorting
[*] New Employee Filter Controls
[*] Two New Melee Weapon Enchantments
[*] A New Shop Policy
[*] Improvements for Large Shops
[*] Prologue Improvements
[*] Eleven New Language Options
[*] Update on Dedicated Servers
[/list]
Happy shopkeeping!

[h2]TinyTeams Festival on August 8th[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a7e6d123241fe9dac3f76a681fbaf9b2291ae1a2.png[/img]
[i]Saleblazers[/i] will be a part of Tiny Teams 2024 hosted by Yogscast Games, so keep an eye out for that soon on [b]August 8th[/b]!

[h2]Ten New Community Advice Tips[/h2]
We added another batch of Community Advice tips from our Discord. Thank you to everyone who submitted tips! If you have tips you want to share with the player base and maybe get featured on the loading screen, make sure to swing by the loading-screen-tips channel over at https://discord.gg/saleblazers


Let's take a look at the nuggets of wisdom from the community this time around:
[list]
[*]"You are never safe. Always be ready to fight." -Anonymous
[*] "Repair hammers can repair your friend's HP in an emergency." -Thiridian
[*] "Pop Pop would be proud of you." -PrinceGK
[*] "Out of items to sell? Abandon your morals and farm your customers!" -ThrillClinton
[*] "It doesn't have to be perfect. It just has to be you!' -PrinceGK
[*] "You can respawn at the most recent totem whether or not you've unlocked it" -cap8
[*] "Spikes, spikes, and more spikes for those pesky intruders" -Aren
[*] "Problems that can't be solved with money can be solved with more money" -Anonymous
[*] "Yes, you can harvest trees with an AK47." -Reisama
[*] "Whenever in doubt, Mop them out." -Fox
[/list]
[h2]Inventory Sorting[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4c33d5260349f595199f49f4b477a9ca46870dfd.gif[/img]
This is one of the most requested features on the Steam Forums and on Discord, so we're very happy to be able to add it in this update. 

Playing with it has improved our own play experience when organizing our shop and when looting gear out in the world. On your player inventory and on other containers, you can now press this sort button and select Alphabetical, Category, or Rarity sorting. We hope this makes organizing your items much more enjoyable!

[h2]Item Category Filter[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1356380e66ac07b7615bfa43edcf7104168d5ecc.png[/img]
Improving the control you have over employees is another highly requested improvement. We are excited to bring you the next step towards that goal with the item category filter. You can now filter the items employees input into containers or displays by category instead of just by item. In the employee input menu, just enable the category filter, and then you can select any number of categories to which you want to limit the container. 

The category filter functions alongside the existing item filter as an either-or, so you can have a container that will accept melee weapons as a category but also accept stones, charcoal, and plant fiber as individual items. This new filter should mean you can set up specific areas of your shop to sell certain items and do the same for storage that your gatherers and crafters use. We also adjusted the logic for the restocking employees so that they will try to prioritize putting large items in large displays and medium items in medium displays.

[h2]Singleplayer Pause Button[/h2]
We've heard that a lot of people want a pause button for when they're playing in singleplayer and need to step away for a bit without being killed by cultists, but we haven't been able to find a way to incorporate it seamlessly with our ESC menu yet. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9e84f96e124bf92869db107b0456a051a972e489.gif[/img]

In the meantime, our summer intern Gawyn has added a manual pause that you can now toggle with (P) if you're playing in singleplayer!

Feel free to change this key binding in the options menu.

He's even turned this into a cool pseudo-photo mode, where you can even orbit your camera around to take a look at your surroundings while everything's frozen! If you are paused when someone else joins your game, it will unpause you.

[h2]Movement Changes[/h2]
We've heard a lot of feedback on our surveys that the game can be clunky for some players. This first set of movement changes is our response to that in making the game feel more free-flowing and relaxing in general, especially for controllers!
[list]
[*] Moving now faces the player towards their input instead of always facing away from the camera
[*] Sprinting is now allowed in all directions instead of only away from the camera
[/list]
[h2]Two New Melee Weapon Enchantments[/h2]
As you probably know, there are a number of enchantments you can add to melee weapons by finding and paying the appropriate NPC in the world. This is a mechanic we know a lot of you enjoy, so we wanted to add two new enchantments to find. These new enchantments are associated with some existing quests and will serve as an improved reward for completing the quests. If you have already completed these quests, head back to the NPCs from the quest, and you will be able to access the enchantments. Details below are spoilered so you can find them yourself if you want to.
[list]
[*][spoiler]Astrid can now add Radiation damage to your weapons after completing her quest[/spoiler]
[*][spoiler]The Bellstalker in the Lighthouse can now add a Frost enchantment to your weapons after completing the Beacons and Bellstalkers quest[/spoiler]
[/list]
[h2]Astrid Quest Updates[/h2]
We heard from a few people that this quest was a bit unforgiving and didn't have the impact we wanted it to. As a first step to alleviate this, we have made the container for the quantum copper respawn its contents every 12 hours. This will allow you to recover more quantum copper if you lose it the first time. 

Because this also means you can make runs to the camp in the crater and get more quantum copper, Astrid will now unlock a recipe to turn quantum copper into regular copper at a recycling machine to give it a practical use outside of the quest. We have also buffed the reward item for this quest to make it more viable.

[h2]Recycling Machine Recipes[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d136f81ed65fcc51c9786a789536feaa89244bef.png[/img]
We also introduced a couple more recipes in the recycling machine that will hopefully make crafting a little bit smoother. You can now turn Abominable Apex Gems and Bellsworn Apex Gems into two regular Apex Gems if you want to use them to craft a North Star component, for instance. We are also aware that Apex Fur should have more uses and will be working on more meaningful uses for it in the future, but for now, we added the ability to turn it into ten leather in the recycling machine.

[h2]Invincible Grabber Ghoul Improvements[/h2]
We heard your feedback that these enemies were too powerful and unfun. For now, we've added more audio and visual feedback to communicate what's going on, nerfed their damage, and re-adjusted spawners. 

You can now hear the Ghouls coming, see roughly where they are around corners or coming up behind you because they emit red light when moving, and know when it's safe to move around them because they emit green light when frozen while you're looking at them. They can still kill you pretty handily, but if you are at very high health, they will no longer kill you in one grab, giving you a chance to get away and recover. 

The Invincible Grabber Ghouls have also all been moved inside of the Bellsworn Proving Grounds maze, so you'll only encounter them after the statue explains how they work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/11f16665dbb619e90766c5a103f8e1a8dae189c9.gif[/img]

Let us know how this feels!

[h2]Boar Rebalancing[/h2]
Another enemy that we've received feedback about is the common Boar. We agree with what we've heard: These enemies can be annoying to deal with early on when you aren't prepared and later in the game when you can deal with them, but they cause a nuisance. 

To address this, we have reduced their aggro radius so they won't attack you quite as often and can be avoided more easily. We've also reduced their speed so you can more comfortably run away from them at a full sprint, and we have changed their behavior to stop chasing you after around 30 meters. This way, you can avoid and escape them more often instead of having to fight every Boar you see.

[h2]New Shop Policy and Improvements for Large Shops[/h2]
We'd like to introduce you to the "All-Inclusive Shopkeeping" shop policy! With it equipped, customers who spend more than 60 seconds shopping in your store will pay 20% extra!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4dafa715b76772f10f499566e62bda1b3b7082ed.png[/img]
Shopping time will only count when they enter their store until they decide on the final item to purchase. To keep them around that long without running out of patience means you'll have to cater to their needs while they shop. We're hoping this policy will serve as a nice reward for those of you building large shops as we realized since it can take customers significantly longer to traverse these shops, smaller shops are more optimal for making money right now. This 20% bonus should help bridge the gap and make larger stores more worthwhile.

Alongside this policy, we also updated customer patience to help alleviate some of the struggles that come with very large shops, especially with shopping baskets. 
[list]
[*] Customers will now regain up to 80% of their patience every time they select an item to add to their shopping basket. This should help ensure you get your customers to the checkout even if they spend a long time selecting three items for their basket.
[*] Medium to low hunger and thirst values now drain less patience from customers. We noticed these two needs were putting a larger-than-expected bottleneck on shops, particularly larger ones. The drain rate for very low hunger and thirst remains the same, so you will still need to make sure this need is met, but if you are at least keeping it to medium levels, the patience drain should be more manageable.
[/list]
[h2]Kitchen and Storage Shelves[/h2]
Many of you have reported confusion around the Kitchen Shelf item as it was mistagged as a display despite being unable to sell items. We have corrected this, but we also felt like the research and iron investment to get the Kitchen Shelf wasn't worth it in its current form. 

To address this, we migrated the existing item to a new node much earlier in the Research Board, changed the recipe to use scrap bars, and changed the name to Storage Shelf. The Kitchen Shelf node now unlocks a Kitchen Shelf Display item that is actually a 6-slot display! The Kitchen Shelf Display can only sell Food, Drinks, and Kitchen items, and gives a 20% sale bonus to Kitchen Items. We hope this brings the item more in line with the fantasy you all had for using it in your shop and preserves the existing shelf as a mid-tier storage item while balancing it by making it easier to craft.

[h2]Prologue Additions[/h2]
To spice up the prologue, we've added 2 NPCs that should make things feel a little more lively. We've also added real soccer goal functionality to the prologue, along with a new Soccer Goal achievement!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/270ba90135c04ea786c39b5ffbb9a2bf2130de07.gif[/img]

[h2]Additional Languages[/h2]
We've added the following languages options to Saleblazers:
[list]
[*] Arabic
[*] Czech
[*] Danish
[*] Dutch
[*] Finnish
[*] Greek
[*] Italian
[*] Norwegian
[*] Swedish
[*] Turkish
[*] Vietnamese
[/list]
These languages fall into the more experimental translation status, but we got them to a point where we wanted to let you use them if you wanted to. 

As always, if you have feedback for improving the translation for these or any of our other languages, please let us know via In-Game report, Steam forum post, or on our Discord (https://discord.gg/saleblazers).

[h2]Update on Dedicated Servers[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/fe456f5c4c94dc3fe7a89e6e1efa75e107422d4e.png[/img]
We see that there's a lot of demand for dedicated servers, so we're investigating it. No promises yet, since we want to prioritize development on the game itself first. It's currently in a stage where we've successfully set up an internal Saleblazers Dedicated Server build and can have players connect through some minor modifications.

If it goes smoothly, we'd really like to add some special features (anti-griefing, player trading) and maybe even game modes (roleplay, survival) for dedicated servers. We'll see what happens!

notes.title: Hotfix v0.14.7.25
notes.notes:
This is a small hotfix to resolve a few issues for some users.

[b]We have received feedback again that we are pushing too many patches and we apologize for this!
[/b]
It's just that sometimes there is an issue that heavily affects a few users and we don't want to leave them waiting too long for the next content patch. 

However, we are as usual trying our best to not push a patch if it is not absolutely necessary. In this case, it was unfortunately necessary despite patching not too long ago.

You can go right click Saleblazers in your Steam Library, select Properties, and disable auto-updates to disable patching for Saleblazers unless you launch it. 

This is a good option since Saleblazers patches are usually pretty small, so you don't need to worry about downloading files for too long when you do decide to launch the game.

notes.title: Take All / Scrap All Shortcuts, Spellbook Buffs, New Bazaar Shops, and More

[h2]Updated Languages[/h2]

Chinese and Spanish have had the most focus so far to improve their translation, but the other languages should also be much better than before. Localization as a whole still isn't perfect, and we plan to keep iterating on these languages throughout Early Access.

[h2]Take All and Scrap All Shortcuts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4c29172493e05892a9d2be444cf574ed628aadf5.png[/img]

We've also added hotkey bindings for Take All and Scrap All in the container menus! This was a great suggestion made to us over on our Saleblazers subreddit.

[h2]More Controller Support (Experimental)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/78e67886589538931e684cc8bb8f8e8af45053cd.gif[/img]

There's now an awesome cursor that better communicates what you've selected when navigating the UI with a controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5fb39025d4243531ef4d03ddd1a8ed3fd91f6e12.gif[/img]

We've also got an all new virtual cursor for most menus, which should bring up the playability for most of the game to not require a mouse and keyboard.

If you play on a Steam Deck and enjoy using the trackpad mouse cursor instead, you can disable the virtual cursor in the gameplay settings.

Keep in mind that we do not officially support controllers yet, so you still may have to switch to keyboard and mouse occasionally to get things working. This patch introduces a lot more controller support, so hopefully you shouldn't have to switch too often.

You can check out the rest of the controller updates down below in the patch notes. Happy shopkeeping!

[h2]Further Improvements to Weapon UI[/h2]
In update 0.14.6.28, we improved the weapon damage UI to display the total damage and the breakdown of base damage plus damage from rarity. With this update, we're continuing to improve this UI by displaying stats for projectile weapons. Spellbooks and mortars now properly display their damage, splash damage, damage radius, elemental attribute effects, as well as stamina and hunger costs.

If you perform a heavy attack with spellbooks by holding down the attack button, you'll now be able to perform a special move where multiple projectiles fly out at once.

We've finally taken the time to fix various issues for 16 shops in Barry's Bazaar with the help of Brandon, our new summer intern. Browsing through wars in Barry's Bazaar should feel a lot less... bizarre. Ha!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d837446c8caf41641668bda40ca6c1a5d0d50daf.png[/img]

notes.title: Small Patch v0.14.6.24
notes.notes:
This is a small patch that resolves some feedback sent in from fellow shopkeepers! 

We're listening to feedback closely and what we're hearing is that players want us to focus on polish and stability, so that's what we'll be working on in the short term. 

[h2]Better Employee Feedback[/h2]
We've also noticed a lot of bug reports of stuck customers/employees due to player shop layout issues such as broken floors, wrong floor types, or wrong employee setups, so we're trying to add more feedback to communicate issues better. 

For example in this patch, we've added bubbles on top of employees' heads when a task is blocked!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/99223808a9501fbfb7736ff3893409b1fac80475.png[/img]
You can also talk to your employees to gain a better understanding of their current status.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ae32772db9225774843297799f356b11d6770628.png[/img]
[h2]More Streamlined Starting Pop Pop Quest[/h2]
As part of the polish pass, we also consolidated some of Pop Pop's starting quests for better quest flow to address player feedback that the starting quest is too long.

We've also added an option to skip to the end of the intro questline if you already know what you're doing or are on your second+ playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/91253d7990b38e8b3e2bdfe11751b39396f9dd35.png[/img]
[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
In future updates, we're planning on adding some more quests and interactions in the starting area to keep you exploring in the first few hours. 

We're not quite sure what that looks like yet, but a big inspiration is to capture the starting zone feel of [i]Fallout: New Vegas[/i] where you're introduced to several side quests early on. There are currently no estimates as to when or how this will be done but we will keep you all updated!

We'll also be looking to add more official localization support for a few languages hopefully in the next 2 weeks.

Special thanks to [b]PhobosReloading[/b] and [b]Jane 🌸[/b] on our Discord for sending us their save files. We wouldn't be able to locate this bug if it weren't for them!

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed government shop shut down trash spawning mechanic
[/list]

[h3]🛠️ General Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed rare case where when an item's optimized state inside an inventory didn't destroy its save data properly which caused several bugs when trying to place an item in its slot and added a fallback to just drop the item on the ground if this still ever happens
[*] Adjusted interactable colliders for Samurai Mask and Leyasoon's Mask to better match its visuals
[*] Fixed typo in Abominable Apex Gem item description
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1675d41325537856ecbb45d8bfbe1a3af0cc9c4b.png[/img]
[*] Plates and Frying Pans now allow items to remain in their inventory slots even when being picked up

[*] Fixed clients failing sales not properly populating the customer review with the rights comments and thumbs downs

notes.title: Employees Update
notes.notes:
We hope you enjoy this new patch! You'll have to read the full patch notes below as we're only highlighting a few of our favorite things here.

[h1]Player Shop Spotlights[/h1]
First, we wanted to show off some of the shops made by the [i]Saleblazers[/i] community sent in to our [url=https://discord.gg/Saleblazers][i]Saleblazers[/i] Discord[/url]!

Here are some shots of some awesome player-built shops that are now featured on our [i]Saleblazers[/i] Steam store page:

[h3]uRBAN_Spaceman[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/378280dadc86062694d82fb3929b6131aa4678fe.png[/img]

[h3]Cyraine[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0313024dea431873d2da8de41b748f3664e4d787.png[/img]

[h3]Jenpai[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/58283a039ff4a7f6847e1894950a223807c8fc64.png[/img]

[h3]doghman[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/847f64180fbcd194422f9502c5ea35cb2b07fdf8.png[/img]
And that's it for now! Thanks for checking out these shops with us.

[h1]New Employee UI[/h1]
In response to many feedback threads about the employee UI being a bit too unwieldy, we've performed an entire rework to the Employee UI! 

Our goal for this rework was to offer at-a-glance insights into how your employees are performing in your shop with as few clicks as possible.

[b]Credits to Steam user "Power"[/b] for jumpstarting this rework with some great ideas: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1419850/discussions/2/4293690852340209785/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/16ade7cea83441153f75a44936464032a41fbb6f.png[/img]
Applicants will now all appear on-screen together in a more visually intuitive way. Chairs represent the maximum number of applicants.

An overview of their basic information is visible all at once in rows, allowing for easier comparisons. Hovering over an applicant's row will also physically highlight the applicant in the 3D view. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5a1aac915f2fdb77f06197069fac22ec40e55aa3.png[/img]
Clicking on an applicant row will bring the camera in for a closer look. We've taken the time to introduce more applicant clothing variety for increased immersion. Gone are the constant clown hats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/345f9b79d155e0dcc9ee83cb716039a752541dd9.png[/img]
The Manage tab now allows you to view all your employees at once, where you can monitor morale levels, current status, schedule availability, wage, and task priority.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/50d3cf0f637c751662a8e21c0ce0152d4297265b.png[/img]
A more detailed view now even shows their needs levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/7d12708f4fbec1568176f47abc794de789164846.png[/img]
The Training page has also received the same treatment!

There's a handful of more changes, but we'll let you check it out for yourself. We hope this will greatly improve the shopkeeping experience and plan to continue improving the employee system throughout Early Access!

[h1]New Edit Appearance Feature[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/117e687c247ca719410ee2ee0f2dfaa00b18c075.png[/img]
The Snowville Barber Shop is now open! Here, you'll be able to edit your character's appearance without having to make another character.

[h1]Optimized Shop Loading System[/h1]
We've dedicated a lot of time to overhauling the save system to asynchronously load save data and stagger out load times for a much smoother experience. 

Here's a comparison of loading times when running to your shop before and after this optimization:

[h2]Before (Single Frame Load)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8b1c9319f07a51473d16c76ecd7396cb284d560e.gif[/img]

[h2]After (Async Load)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/8a50db8601245370479679650ad7cd65fa15a574.gif[/img]

We'll be looking into polishing this more with a cool effect later down the road. We just wanted to make this change live as soon as possible since a lot of players have been asking for this.

Thank you to all the players on the Steam forums and https://discord.gg/Saleblazers for sending in reports and save files!

[h1]In-game Bug Reporting[/h1]
We really appreciate all the effort you have put into reporting issues and sending us to save files, and we understand that it is a hassle to do so.

We've added a new in-game bug reporting button under the ESC -> Help menu to make this a little easier!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/73526ebcc9d07e9a1d28881aaa76d8cd913a926a.jpg[/img]

We use Google Drive to store the save files, so keep in mind that it might not work if your country doesn't allow Google services.

[h1]General Polish[/h1]
This patch introduces a lot of polish, balance changes, and stability fixes from player feedback. We'll continue to keep a close eye on Steam and Discord. Read more in the patch notes below!

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
For the next few patches, we plan to keep [b]polishing and optimizing[/b] what we currently have. We're already planning a followup build to resolve some minor issues. 

Once we feel good about the state of the game, we'll be moving on to more features towards 1.0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/b72d6656d0ff390a39140e7d509eb6e51d26fb3a.png[/img]

Earlier in the year, we talked about updating the art for mountain ranges which should provide visual and performance benefits. To give you an update, we're still working on this. You can take a look at the splash screen in this latest patch to see what it'll look like in-game!

Have fun shopkeepers!

notes.title: Customer AI Navigation Polish Patch v0.14.5.19
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1a48730c68bbca76d5ae4a25e31794b756083f22.png[/img]

This is a small patch to improve AI pathfinding in general with the help of community reports. We apologize for your experience and thank you for your patience!

To keep new players up to date: we usually have an update cadence of content patch -> hotfix -> small patch -> hotfix -> content patch -> and so on.

We'll stay vigilant and won't move on to the next content patch until we feel satisfied with the current state of the game.

Thank you for the help and for sending us your save files! We do lots of testing on our end and don't expect people to send them in (we just want you to enjoy the game), but the save files made it significantly faster to pinpoint scenarios where issues can happen more frequently. 

We'll still be monitoring feedback and performing more tests on our end to ensure everything is ironed out properly. Happy shopkeeping!

notes.title: Catch me if you can! - Update 14.5
notes.notes:
This patch introduces a lot of new and improved features!

Also, consider catching up on some of our smaller patches and hotfixes as they can also contain substantial content. For example, in the last patch we made melee staggers more consistent which was a pretty big buff to melee weapons: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1419850/view/4205873192593826999

[h1]Enemies Can Now Parkour to Kill You[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/15b949964aa147b1c7d8d2c359e674914d24b858.gif[/img]

Previously if you climbed up something, enemies would circle around your location and fail to attack you.

Now, enemies are now much smarter and can now climb up towards your location! Fights against Apexes will be a little tougher if you relied on climbing up on rocks to defeat them...

We're really excited to bring you this feature and hope that it'll bring you countless hours of fun moments. With this new mechanic, the game feels even more dynamic and inches us closer to our vision of [i]Saleblazers [/i]1.0!

[h1]Sprinklers for Farming[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/07c3fd1936d6550063339d528fa6833cf3ade282.gif[/img]
An all new electric sprinkler item is our first step towards automated farming.

You can research and craft it using water and electronics. Once you hook it up to power, it will automatically water all the crops around it. This lets you grow your crops without worrying about coming through to water them every day.

We also updated the water and wet particles with the addition of the sprinkler. We think walking through your farm and listening to the light spray of the sprinkler as the water shines in the sun is pretty nice. We can't wait to see your farm setups with this addition!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/a38440b2427cac24182574f54ae0d743c56562af.gif[/img]

[h1]New Rain and Water Interactions with Plants[/h1]
Special thanks to [b]KatVet[/b] on https://discord.gg/Saleblazers for the following suggestions that we've now implemented this patch.

[h3]Rain Will Water Unroofed Plants[/h3]
You can now take advantage of rainy weather to forgo the usage of sprinklers or watering cans! Just make sure you build an open roof for your plants.

[h3]Planting Rice in Water[/h3]
Placing plants in water will cause most crops to be destroyed. For Rice, they'll thrive in fresh or dirty water, maxing out their water need so you won't need to water them!

[h1]Mannequins[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/0eb40b8f4e327eb19af8af790f25e02349aff3f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/bd9bff0da91f7bca67135c475953e1f3b0f8b15a.png[/img]

This update introduces mannequins, which you can use to decorate your shop and showcase equipment that you have crafted or gathered.

You can research the 10 available mannequin poses and craft them using plastic. Then, you can craft and dress them however you like. They can even hold items to complete their look.

[h3]Armor Stand[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/bfadefcbef3a911f456f79f91e3a0c9092a62df7.png[/img]

This functionality was also added to the armor stand, which many of you have already been using in your shops. 

Now that the armor stand wears equipment properly, we've added it to the research tree to make it more available. Existing armor stands should still function, but they will have some extra generic slots that new ones won't have.

Customers will purchase items from the armor stand but not from mannequins, as they are just for decorating.

We look forward to checking out what gear you showcase on your mannequins and what scenes you set up with them to decorate your bases.


[h1]Tree Felling Update[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e585d5c5d09a13308daac06fce1fc26ca6e185ac.gif[/img]

We've taken the time to polish our tree cutting mechanic!
[list]
[*] Falling physics have been significantly improved
[*] Better VFX, SFX, and visual polish
[*] A lot more resources spawn in with significantly less lag
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/9a0117bc5622ad45735b24ecbac5f765e12061be.gif[/img]

Also, you can now deal damage to trees to make them disappear faster.

[h1]Item Drop Optimization and QoL Rework[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/21d10b98b08c9bcaf601ea6d78cd375bd2a76d9e.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/1f4f6c7376585da7ad07e68937a97628ab18c7a3.gif[/img]
You may have noticed in the tree felling GIFs that droppable items look a little different. After seeing some ridiculous tree farms in the [i]Saleblazers [/i]community, we've spent a good amount of time optimizing how they work as well as add some highly-requested quality of life changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/528276be6888c878cc2a45ac35db3c4f2ff2fbc6.gif[/img]

Now, droppables will:
[list]
[*] Float when spawned so you can see them better in tall grass and distinguish them from regular items
[*] Magnetize to your character when nearby for easy access
[*] Be much more lightweight in its code which results in a lot less lag, which allows us to have a higher quantity of dropped items across the game!
[/list]
[h1]Stamina Fatigue Mechanic[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/3aa07b7847da03b8db5284010b160a756351060f.gif[/img]
When your stamina reaches 0, your character will enter a fatigued state where stamina regeneration is briefly delayed. 

[h1]Increased Melee Damage[/h1]
The stamina fatigue mechanic now allows us to heavily increase high-stamina weapon damage and melee rarity damage scaling. 

This adds on to our previous set of buffs here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1419850/view/4205873192593826999

Our goal is to bring melee weapons up to the power level of guns in a way that is high risk high reward with a dose of strong crowd control.

[h3]Melee Weapon Trail Polish[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/90839e49e085af9ca526bb0e30ef197bb26e5973.gif[/img]
Melee weapon trails also received a polish pass to reflect increased melee power! 

[h3]Blood Messes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/02020f600ed7a450370fe5cb9a1040fbd5b7c68a.png[/img]
We've also added blood messes that appear when you deal critical melee damage. Blood messes can be cleaned up by employees or through using the Mop.

[h1]Enemies Can Now Target Buildings[/h1]
We'll be monitoring this change closely for balance feedback. 

To make things smoother, melee attacks now no longer register through walls and walls are much more resistant to melee attacks.

[h1]Improved Airstrafer Base Prologue[/h1]
We've heard lots of feedback about the prologue and will be continuously polishing it throughout Early Access. In this patch, we've polished several parts of the prologue.

Feel free to leave some of your own in https://discord.gg/Saleblazers or the [i]Saleblazers [/i]Steam forums!

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We're working on a few things at the same time:
[list]
[*] The usual string of hotfixes post-patch
[*] Reworked employee UI
[*] Proper language support
[*] Map changes
[*] Optimization
[/list]

After this, we're planning on adding more content towards 1.0! 

We'd appreciate if you left a Steam review for us as it helps development tremendously.

notes.title: v0.14.4.17 - Melee Combat Balancing
notes.notes:
This is a [b]small patch [/b]to improve melee attack handling, to address a specific scenario where customers would spawn in larger groups than intended, and to slightly improve AI pathfinding around doors.

We anticipate that this will be the last patch before our next content update. We're currently in the testing phase of the next patch, so hopefully we'll be able to release it next week!

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]

[*] Melee attacks will now push enemies away from where you're facing for more consistent melee gameplay (you can choose where to push NPCs much more easily now, especially with a large pole or furniture weapon)
[*] Melee attacks deal more stagger to NPCs than to players
[*] NPC lunge behavior tweaked to be more subtle
[*] Spinning rotation removed from melee lunges
[*] All self damage on melee hits reduced to 1 (previously it would be as high as 20 for some items)
[*] Sword and katana movesets are now faster

[*] Added new quest accepted and quest completed sounds

[*] Crab hitbox adjusted to be taller so that they're easier to hit
[*] Updated Rune and Totem sounds
[*] Apex combat behavior changed to leap less often
[*] Updated some crafting VFX
[*] Improved several cutscene camera angles in prologue
[*] Improved AI pathfinding in prologue

notes.notes:
We've heard lots of feedback on melee combat and made some changes! 

This patch aims to make melee combat against NPCs feel more consistent on par with ranged weaponry through various fixes and changes to stagger/knockdown/attack states.

It also addresses a save issue causing Pop Pop not to spawn in some player's worlds after completing part of his quest line as well as an issue blocking the Miner Setback quest to recover the Chilling Bell.

[h3]⚔️ NPC Melee Combat Changes[/h3]

notes.title: Under Attack - Update 14.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Turrets[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2571eed354ee016068c71572b59231b77d815541.png[/img]
For some time, you have requested to add more ways to defend your shop or home. We agree this is an excellent addition to Saleblazers, so we're excited to introduce automatic turrets in this patch!
There are 16 new turrets to research and craft, starting with the meager rock thrower and working up to electric-powered M4 and AWP turrets.
[list][*] Mk. I turrets are coal-powered and feature some early-game ranged weapons.
[*] Mk. II turrets need to be hooked up to a generator and boast more firepower.
[*] Mk. III turrets require even more electricity but feature the highest-tier firepower in the game.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/752b2b602bdba59151baddb0470a81f53f0c692e.gif[/img]

After researching the turrets, you can craft them at the weapon forge. We can't wait to see your turret defense set-ups in the Community Hub screenshots or on our Discord channel!

[h1]Defensive Spikes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/2820feb7f5719c4d2e60ac9f05fdc0e3aaeb21da.png[/img]
We're also introducing Bamboo, Wood, and Carbon Iron spike traps to the research tree to supplement your turret defenses. These spikes can be crafted in the Sawmill and placed around your shop. Enemies will try to run through them but will be forced to slow to walking speed and take damage over time while they do.

The spikes' damage increases as you use better materials to craft them, and the Carbon Iron spike traps can withstand significant damage before breaking.

[h1]Nighttime Attacks[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e5c8cf0a2d0e92e828382721bf73edd3b05a50db.png[/img]
We've added some new nighttime attack mechanics in the Under Attack update. Once the sun goes down, there is a chance for Ghouls to spawn around your location and attack you. These attacks can occur while exploring or in the shop plot, so consider making your way to a defensible location once it starts getting dark. Your new turrets and spike traps should help you keep your shop safe and running overnight, but you can always sleep through the night to avoid the bulk of these attacks.

We plan on adding more depth to the system for attacking shop plots, including more ways to counter these attacks, so we look forward to hearing your feedback on this mechanic. We've been having a good time setting up turret kill zones at our shops for these enemies, so we hope you also find they make the nighttime gameplay more exciting.
[h3]Peaceful Night Setting[/h3]
We know that some players aren't fans of being attacked at the shop and would prefer to continue shopkeeping in peace, so we have added a Peaceful Night lobby configuration setting that will allow you to turn off these new attacks, as well as the existing Watcher Ghoul spawns around the shop plots. Regular enemies can still chase you to the shop, but we hope this will also be a good first step towards accommodating more peaceful gameplay.

[h1]Clothing Dye Station[/h1]
We heard you wanted some more control over the color of your clothing and general appearance. The first step toward that goal is the Clothing Dye Station. With this workbench, you can input a piece of clothing and some clothing dye and select which colorway you want to apply to that item. After researching the dye station, you can craft clothing dye in your crafting table using coffee beans, plant fiber, seaweed, coal, or ink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/f2320fcc36a74c24ad470a2f5de540485cdcf66d.png[/img]

[h1]Steam Spring Sale and Pre-Sale Early Supporter Bonuses[/h1]
We're working on getting Saleblazers out to as many people as possible to get more shops up and running, more worlds to invade, more friends to build the North Star with, and more resources to continue developing toward our 1.0 release.

To reach more players, we're excited to announce we will be participating in the Steam Spring sale later this week!

However, we want to ensure that all of our players who have already supported us get a proper thank you, as we couldn't be where we are today without you. So, anyone who purchased or activated the game before 03/14/2024 will unlock some exclusive items.
[list][*] Gold Nameplate and Airstrafer Insignia
[*] Gold Airstrafer Jacket Colorway
[*] Black and Gold Airstrafer Apron Colorway
[*] Supporter Medallion
[*] Black and Gold Airstrafer Wallpaper
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/4ca9053a733532ab8012096730c6e2909e40791e.png[/img]
This is the perfect opportunity to try out the new Clothing Dye Bench. Your exclusive colorways will be available when you dye an apron or any of the Airstrafer jackets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/5fca88eddc5f6cc77270060e9c9c2f2812515425.png[/img]
You can swap between the gold nameplate and the normal white one from the ESC menu using these arrows.

The Traveler will also have a special message from us to you, so head over to Invasion Island and chat with him when you can.

The rewards and the Traveler's message can be claimed at any time if your purchase or activation date meets the requirements, so there is no rush to claim it.
We are hoping to do more time-gated colorways and nameplates like this for other big moments like our 1.0 release and potentially as achievement unlocks, so let us know what you think of them.

[h1]Hold to Pick Up Containers and Large Items[/h1]
By popular demand, you now have to hold down the pickup button for containers and large items so that you don't accidentally pick them up and spill their contents everywhere.

[b] Items will still spill out when picked up[/b]. This change only makes accidental pickups less common. It's also a much-needed balance change to prevent spam throwing large items to ragdoll people.

Thank you to everyone who has brought up this suggestion and been part of discussions surrounding it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/ec70fe26c5aaf9775244c86fd66e7082e2ced9ad.gif[/img]

[h1]New Quarry Quest[/h1]
You can now find a small camp of refugees south of the quarry. Talk to them to start a new quest in the area where you can free some Ronin captives from the mines.

The reward for this quest is[spoiler]the new first NPC Summon item since the License to Sell update introduced the summon walkie-talkies[/spoiler]. We think it's pretty fun and look forward to seeing you try it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/458e642d95156136948c18919b3003ed597e6f0c.png[/img]
As a part of implementing this quest, we also optimized the quarry and redid some of the paths and ziplines to make it more fun to traverse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/781307ecd9cf833521cffb402eefc246fefe2019.png[/img]
We believe this quest fills out this part of the world more and adds some goals for the quarry area, which was previously more of a sandbox dungeon zone. We hope you enjoy it!

[h1]Boiling Cups and Bowls of Water[/h1]
As another survival tool to handle dehydration, you can now use your campfire or stove to boil dirty or salt water collected in cups or bowls to make it safe to drink.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/d56a59215b0d02362bc6fd5bcf778217da25e29d.png[/img]
[h1]Experimental Outpost Clearing and Raid System[/h1]

We're working on a new feature to make outposts more fun to find, explore, and clear out. Outposts will have a name, and the faction that owns them will be displayed when you enter. A cleared percentage bar will display your progress as you fight the enemies inside. An additional reward will spawn once you defeat all the enemies in an outpost. Currently, this reward will be a chest of items based on the outpost. Once cleared, the Outpost UI will display the time until the outpost resets and can be cleared again.
Every time you clear an outpost, you risk triggering a retaliation attack from the faction that owns it.

We think this clarity and additional rewards make outposts more fun to discover and make farming outpost loot clearer and more rewarding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41695305/e814b27dca0a965f69c87e61089807448f06e057.png[/img]
So far, we have only made this experimental feature live on a few outposts for you to try out. You can try this mechanic at the following outposts near the starting area:
[list]
[*] Ruins Overlook Outpost
[*] Skull Coast Forward Outpost
[*] Skull Camp Major Outpost
[/list]

[h3]➡️ Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added clothing dye station and clothing dye items to recolor apparel
[*] Added early supporter colorways for the airstrafer jackets and apron
[*] Added early supporter wallpaper
[*] Added early supporter nameplate that can be equipped from the ESC menu
[*] Added message for early supporters from the Traveler
[*] You now have to hold down the pickup button for containers and large items so that you don't accidentally pick them up and to balance throwing large items to ragdoll people
[*] Added new quest to the quarry
